- `E1.S3`: ERROR DESCRIPTION
 *  The "MQ Advanced V8.0 Virtual System Pattern Type for IBM
   PureApplication System Multilingual (CN7AEML)" includes a
   template "IBM MQ Multi-instance with 2 pairs" that includes
   a default value  for the "Storage Maximum limit (K,M,G)" of
   100M which is insufficient for 2 queue managers.
- `E1.S4`: When creating IBM MQ Virtual System Pattern Type patterns from
   existing templates with this preset default GPFS storage
   limitation value, the pattern with a pair of HA Multi-instance
   IBM MQ components will fail to deploy.
- `E1.S5`: One or both of the following might be witnessed:
    The active and standby queue manager in the VM fail to start.
    The trace.log shows the IBM MQ error (893).
- `E1.S6`: LOCAL FIX
 *  When using the provided template to create your pattern, change
   the GPFS storage maximum value to 1G or higher depending on your
   requirements.
- `E1.S7`: PROBLEM SUMMARY
 *  ****************************************************************
   USERS AFFECTED:
   Users of the IBM MQ Virtual System Pattern Type patterns from
   existing templates with a preset default GPFS storage limitation
   value.
- `E1.S8`: Platforms affected:
   MultiPlatform
- `E1.S9`: ****************************************************************
   PROBLEM DESCRIPTION:
   The pattern failed to deploy because the GPFS storage maximum
   limitation value in the pattern template provided was set too
   low. The value in the pattern template was 100M but should be
   higher.
- `E1.S10`: Each queue manager requires approximately 100M of space when
   created but this storage requirement will increase with further
   configuration and runtime processing of messages. The same GPFS
   partition might be used in multiple deploys, so the
   configuration needs to allow enough storage for the required
   workload
- `E1.S11`: PROBLEM CONCLUSION
 *  The IBM MQ Virtual System Pattern Type pattern template has been
   updated to set the GPFS storage maximum limitation value to 1G

- `E2.S1`: TECHNOTE (TROUBLESHOOTING)
- `E2.S2`: PROBLEM(ABSTRACT)
 Users observe errors when attempting to install or migrate to IBM MQ 8.0.0.4 using IBM Pure Application System.
- `E2.S3`: SYMPTOM
Users observe errors when attempting to install or migrate to IBM MQ 8.0.0.4 using the following levels of IBM Pure Application System:
- `E2.S4`: * 2.1.2.0 
 * 2.2.0.0 and later
- `E2.S5`: This affects users with IBM MQ Pure Application System pattern-types 1.0.0.2 and earlier. 
CAUSE
Because of an interface change in IBM Pure Application System 2.1.2.0, and in 2.2.0.0 and greater, installation and upgrade of IBM MQ at the latest maintenance level contained in the pattern-type fails. The installation appears to succeed, but IBM MQ 8.0.0.2 is installed and the subsequent fixpack update is not applied. This affects IBM MQ Pure Application System pattern-types 1.0.0.2 and earlier, leading to the following restrictions:
- `E2.S6`: * For IBM Pure Application System releases earlier than 2.1.2.0 and at version 2.1.2.1, you can install all versions of IBM MQ contained in the pattern-type. You can also apply maintenance to running pattern instances. 
 * For IBM Pure Application System 2.1.2.0, 2.2.0.0 and later, you can install IBM MQ 8.0.0.2 only. You cannot install later versions e.g., 8.0.0.4. You cannot apply maintenance to running pattern instances.
- `E2.S7`: RESOLVING THE PROBLEM
A new maintenance.py lifecycle script is available to enable installation and migration of the latest maintenance level of IBM MQ contained in the pattern-type.
- `E2.S8`: This update, and installation steps, can be obtained from IBM Fix Central:
- `E2.S9`: http://www.ibm.com/support/fixcentral/swg/quickorder?parent=ibm%7EWebSphere&product=ibm/WebSphere/WebSphere+MQ&release=8.0&platform=All&function=fixId&fixids=1.0.0.2-WS-MQ-Pure-LAIT15252&includeSupersedes=0&source=fc [http://www.ibm.com/support/fixcentral/swg/quickorder?parent=ibm%7EWebSphere&product=ibm/WebSphere/WebSphere+MQ&release=8.0&platform=All&function=fixId&fixids=1.0.0.2-WS-MQ-Pure-LAIT15252&includeSupersedes=0&source=fc]
- `E2.S10`: APAR IT15252 has been raised for the IBM MQ development team to address this issue within future releases of the IBM MQ Pure Application System pattern-type.
- `E3.S1`: create an empty directory (with sufficient space to receive the download file) and make it current. 
2. Download mqc8_platform to this directory. (Where 'platform' is replaced with a specific platform name e.g. AIX, Linux-x86)
3. Uncompress mqc8_platform.
4. Execute tar -xvf mqc8_platform.
5. Execute rm mqc8_platform.
6. Follow the instructions provided in the IBM MQ V8 Knowledge Center to complete the installation of the client.

   manager-update-packages-dialog-does-n/
- `E4.S9`: To confirm that APAR IT14680 is the root cause of a problem
   where a fix is not listed properly on the Manage > Maintenance
   page:
- `E4.S10`: Confirm that Installation Manager lists the fix as available:
   - SSH onto the virtual machine where the fix needs to be applied
   - Update your SSH tool settings so that the commands you issue
     and their output are saved in a file
   - Issue the following commands
- `E4.S11`: sudo -u virtuser ./imcl listAvailableFixes <fix-name>
   -repositories http://IBMWorkloadDeployer:8585/IMRepository/Compo [http://IBMWorkloadDeployer:8585/IMRepository/Compo]
- `E4.S12`: where <fix-name> is the name of the fix to be applied, for
   example:
- `E4.S13`: sudo -u virtuser ./imcl listAvailableFixes
   com.ibm.websphere.liberty.ND.v85_8.5.5009.20160227_1546
   -repositories http://IBMWorkloadDeployer:8585/IMRepository/Compo [http://IBMWorkloadDeployer:8585/IMRepository/Compo]
- `E4.S14`: If an external Installation Manager Repository is also
   available, also issue
- `E4.S15`: sudo -u virtuser ./imcl listAvailableFixes <fix-name>
   -repositories http://<external-IM-repository> [http://<external-IM-repository>]
- `E4.S16`: where <fix-name> is the name of the fix to be applied, and
   <external-IM-repository>  is the URL for the external IM
   repository.
- `E4.S17`: Enable tracing to collect logs with fixpack calculation
   information included:
- `E4.S18`: - Select System > Workload Troubleshooting
   - Add a trace for
     "com.ibm.maestro.mgmt.resources.IfixMgmtResource"
   - Set the trace level to ALL
   - Recreate the problem
   - Wait 2 hours
   - Select System > Workload Troubleshooting again
   - Download All Logs
        (take care *not* to choose Download Latest Logs)
   - Provide the trace.zip file to IBM support
- `E4.S19`: To review the logs for information
   - Unzip trace.zip and look for servers.zip
   - Unzip servers.zip
   - Unzip the Kernel Services logs inside servers.zip
   - Review the Kernel Services logs for log entries from
     IfixMgmtResource.
- `E4.S20`: PROBLEM SUMMARY
 *  The code checking if a fix is applicable to a product installed
   on a virtual machine was expecting to compare versions for
   maintenance in the V.R.M.F formart (version, release,
   maintenance, fix). The Java fix had an unhandled version
   format.
- `E4.S21`: PROBLEM CONCLUSION
 *  A code fix is being provided in PureApplication System version
   2.2.0.0.
- `E4.S22`: TEMPORARY FIX

- `E5.S1`: SECURITY BULLETIN
- `E5.S2`: SUMMARY
 There are multiple vulnerabilities in IBM® SDK Java™ Technology Edition Version 6 and 7 that are used by IBM OS Images for Red Hat Linux Systems and AIX. These issues were disclosed as part of the IBM Java SDK updates in January 2015.
- `E5.S3`: VULNERABILITY DETAILS
CVEID: CVE-2015-0410 [http://cve.mitre.org/cgi-bin/cvename.cgi?name=CVE-2015-0410]
DESCRIPTION: An unspecified vulnerability related to the Security component could allow a remote attacker to cause a denial of service.
CVSS Base Score: 5
CVSS Temporal Score: See https://exchange.xforce.ibmcloud.com/vulnerabilities/100151 [https://exchange.xforce.ibmcloud.com/vulnerabilities/100151] for the current score
CVSS Environmental Score*: Undefined
CVSS Vector: (AV:N/AC:L/Au:N/C:N/I:N/A:P)
- `E5.S4`: CVEID: CVE-2014-6593 [http://cve.mitre.org/cgi-bin/cvename.cgi?name=CVE-2014-6593]
DESCRIPTION: An unspecified vulnerability related to the JSSE component has partial confidentiality impact, partial integrity impact, and no availability impact.
CVSS Base Score: 4
CVSS Temporal Score: See https://exchange.xforce.ibmcloud.com/vulnerabilities/100153 [https://exchange.xforce.ibmcloud.com/vulnerabilities/100153] for the current score
CVSS Environmental Score*: Undefined
CVSS Vector: (AV:N/AC:H/Au:N/C:P/I:P/A:N)
- `E5.S5`: AFFECTED PRODUCTS AND VERSIONS
IBM OS Image for Red Hat Linux Systems 2.0.0.1 and earlier.
IBM OS Image for AIX 2.0.0.1 and earlier.
- `E5.S6`: REMEDIATION/FIXES
The deployed Red Hat Linux-based and AIX virtual machines on IBM PureApplication Systems types are affected. The solution is to apply the following IBM PureApplication System fix to the deployed virtual machines.
- `E5.S7`: Java Update for Linux
http://www-933.ibm.com/support/fixcentral/swg/selectFixes?parent=PureSystems&product=ibm/WebSphere/PureApplication+System&release=All&platform=All&function=fixId&fixids=+Java_Update_Linux_2++&includeSupersedes=0 [http://www-933.ibm.com/support/fixcentral/swg/selectFixes?parent=PureSystems&product=ibm/WebSphere/PureApplication+System&release=All&platform=All&function=fixId&fixids=+Java_Update_Linux_2++&includeSupersedes=0]
- `E5.S8`: Java Update for AIX
http://www-933.ibm.com/support/fixcentral/swg/selectFixes?parent=PureSystems&product=ibm/WebSphere/PureApplication+System&release=All&platform=All&function=fixId&fixids=+Java_Update_AIX_2++&includeSupersedes=0 [http://www-933.ibm.com/support/fixcentral/swg/selectFixes?parent=PureSystems&product=ibm/WebSphere/PureApplication+System&release=All&platform=All&function=fixId&fixids=+Java_Update_AIX_2++&includeSupersedes=0]
- `E5.S9`: 1. Import the fix into the Emergency Fix catalogue. 
 2. For deployed instances, apply this emergency fix on the VM. The IBM Java SDKwill be upgraded to IBM Java JDK 7.0 SR8 FP10 interim fix and IBM Java JDK 6.0 SR16 FP3 interim fix 
 3. Restart the deployed instance after the fix is applied.
- `E5.S10`: You should verify applying this fix does not cause any compatibility issues. WORKAROUNDS AND MITIGATIONS
None

 Subscribe to My Notifications [ http://www-01.ibm.com/software/support/einfo.html] to be notified of important product support alerts like this.

Status: `ANSWER`

Visible answer:
IBM provided a new maintenance.py lifecycle script to enable installation and migration to the latest MQ maintenance level contained in the pattern type; the update and installation steps are available from IBM Fix Central. APAR IT15252 was raised to address the issue in future MQ PureApplication System pattern-type releases. [E2.S7] [E2.S8] [E2.S10]

=== CANDIDATE B ===

Model-visible evidence:
- `E1.S1`: TECHNOTE (TROUBLESHOOTING)
- `E1.S2`: PROBLEM(ABSTRACT)
 Users observe errors when attempting to install or migrate to IBM MQ 8.0.0.4 using IBM Pure Application System.
- `E1.S3`: SYMPTOM
Users observe errors when attempting to install or migrate to IBM MQ 8.0.0.4 using the following levels of IBM Pure Application System:
- `E1.S4`: * 2.1.2.0 
 * 2.2.0.0 and later
- `E1.S5`: This affects users with IBM MQ Pure Application System pattern-types 1.0.0.2 and earlier. 
CAUSE
Because of an interface change in IBM Pure Application System 2.1.2.0, and in 2.2.0.0 and greater, installation and upgrade of IBM MQ at the latest maintenance level contained in the pattern-type fails. The installation appears to succeed, but IBM MQ 8.0.0.2 is installed and the subsequent fixpack update is not applied. This affects IBM MQ Pure Application System pattern-types 1.0.0.2 and earlier, leading to the following restrictions:
- `E1.S6`: * For IBM Pure Application System releases earlier than 2.1.2.0 and at version 2.1.2.1, you can install all versions of IBM MQ contained in the pattern-type. You can also apply maintenance to running pattern instances. 
 * For IBM Pure Application System 2.1.2.0, 2.2.0.0 and later, you can install IBM MQ 8.0.0.2 only. You cannot install later versions e.g., 8.0.0.4. You cannot apply maintenance to running pattern instances.
- `E1.S7`: RESOLVING THE PROBLEM
A new maintenance.py lifecycle script is available to enable installation and migration of the latest maintenance level of IBM MQ contained in the pattern-type.
- `E1.S8`: This update, and installation steps, can be obtained from IBM Fix Central:
- `E1.S9`: http://www.ibm.com/support/fixcentral/swg/quickorder?parent=ibm%7EWebSphere&product=ibm/WebSphere/WebSphere+MQ&release=8.0&platform=All&function=fixId&fixids=1.0.0.2-WS-MQ-Pure-LAIT15252&includeSupersedes=0&source=fc [http://www.ibm.com/support/fixcentral/swg/quickorder?parent=ibm%7EWebSphere&product=ibm/WebSphere/WebSphere+MQ&release=8.0&platform=All&function=fixId&fixids=1.0.0.2-WS-MQ-Pure-LAIT15252&includeSupersedes=0&source=fc]
- `E1.S10`: APAR IT15252 has been raised for the IBM MQ development team to address this issue within future releases of the IBM MQ Pure Application System pattern-type.
- `E2.S1`: SUBSCRIBE
You can track all active APARs for this component.
- `E2.S2`: APAR STATUS
 * CLOSED AS PROGRAM ERROR.
- `E2.S3`: ERROR DESCRIPTION
 *  The "MQ Advanced V8.0 Virtual System Pattern Type for IBM
   PureApplication System Multilingual (CN7AEML)" includes a
   template "IBM MQ Multi-instance with 2 pairs" that includes
   a default value  for the "Storage Maximum limit (K,M,G)" of
   100M which is insufficient for 2 queue managers.
- `E2.S4`: When creating IBM MQ Virtual System Pattern Type patterns from
   existing templates with this preset default GPFS storage
   limitation value, the pattern with a pair of HA Multi-instance
   IBM MQ components will fail to deploy.
- `E2.S5`: One or both of the following might be witnessed:
    The active and standby queue manager in the VM fail to start.
    The trace.log shows the IBM MQ error (893).
- `E2.S6`: LOCAL FIX
 *  When using the provided template to create your pattern, change
   the GPFS storage maximum value to 1G or higher depending on your
   requirements.
- `E2.S7`: PROBLEM SUMMARY
 *  ****************************************************************
   USERS AFFECTED:
   Users of the IBM MQ Virtual System Pattern Type patterns from
   existing templates with a preset default GPFS storage limitation
   value.
- `E2.S8`: Platforms affected:
   MultiPlatform
- `E2.S9`: ****************************************************************
   PROBLEM DESCRIPTION:
   The pattern failed to deploy because the GPFS storage maximum
   limitation value in the pattern template provided was set too
   low. The value in the pattern template was 100M but should be
   higher.
- `E2.S10`: Each queue manager requires approximately 100M of space when
   created but this storage requirement will increase with further
   configuration and runtime processing of messages. The same GPFS
   partition might be used in multiple deploys, so the
   configuration needs to allow enough storage for the required
   workload
- `E2.S11`: PROBLEM CONCLUSION
 *  The IBM MQ Virtual System Pattern Type pattern template has been
   updated to set the GPFS storage maximum limitation value to 1G
- `E2.S12`: ---------------------------------------------------------------
   The fix is targeted for delivery in the following PTFs:
- `E2.S13`: Version    Maintenance Level
   v8.0       8.0.0.5
- `E2.S14`: The latest available maintenance can be obtained from
   'WebSphere MQ Recommended Fixes'
   http://www-1.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?rs=171&uid=swg27006037 [http://www-1.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?rs=171&uid=swg27006037]
- `E2.S15`: If the maintenance level is not yet available information on
   its planned availability can be found in 'WebSphere MQ
   Planned Maintenance Release Dates'
   http://www-1.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?rs=171&uid=swg27006309 [http://www-1.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?rs=171&uid=swg27006309]
   ---------------------------------------------------------------

- `E3.S1`: Websphere MS Series; WS MQ Async Receive Adapter; WS MQ Series Client Suite; Memory Leak; Java Out of Memory; OOM TECHNOTE (TROUBLESHOOTING)
- `E3.S2`: PROBLEM(ABSTRACT)
 A customer has installed the MQ Series *.jar files and implemened the WS MQ Series Asycn Receive Adapter and the WS MQ Series Client services to read and write messages from queues.
- `E3.S3`: SYMPTOM
After running the application for a few days it would hang and the Heap memory space was full.
Garbage Collection runs were not able to free up any memory and GC logs were showing the pattern of a memory leak.
- `E3.S4`: CAUSE
In the heap dump files 84% of the memory space was occupied by the following class:
com/ibm/mq/jmqi/remote/impl/RemoteConnectionPool
- `E3.S5`: ENVIRONMENT
Production and QA.
- `E3.S6`: DIAGNOSING THE PROBLEM
To diagnose the situation enable verbose GS logging in the JVM. Analyse GC logs over a period of time and they should reveal a slow progressive increase in the heap size with the typical pattern of a memory leak.
You can also generate some heapdump files when the heap size is full and search which objects are occupying the memory.
- `E3.S7`: RESOLVING THE PROBLEM
Go in the Sterling B2B Integrator in the /install/properties directory and review the dynamicclasspath.cfg file.
- `E3.S8`: Verify that all the required jar files are been installed:
- `E3.S9`: VENDOR_JAR=/home/sb2bi_user/install/jar/ibm_mq/9_0/com.ibm.mq.allclient.jar
VENDOR_JAR=/home/sb2bi_user/install/jar/ibm_mq/9_0/com.ibm.mq.axis2.jar

- `E3.S10`: When we verified the size of the files installed in Sterling B2B Integrator and compared them with the *.jar files on the WS MQ Server and we noticed there was a substantial difference in the size of the files.
We found out the libraries installed were from WS MQ version 9.0.0.0 and the WS MQ Server was in version 9.0.0.2.
- `E3.S11`: The customer went on the WS MQ Server under the /install_dir/java/lib and copied the correct version of all the jar files.
He then replaced them in all the folders referenced in the dynamicclasspath.cfg file and restarted the application.
After the restart the memory leak problem was resolved and GC logs were showing stable memory consumption.

- `E5.S10`: PROBLEM SUMMARY
 *  ****************************************************************
   USERS AFFECTED:
   This issue affects two categories of user:
- `E5.S11`: 1. Users of the WebSphere MQ command runmqsc who run:
- `E5.S12`: DISPLAY CHSTATUS(channel name)
- `E5.S13`: to display the status of a channel.
- `E5.S14`: 2. Users of the WebSphere MQ Explorer who display the status of
   a Channel by highlighting a Channel in the Channels pane, right
   clicking and selecting Status->Channel Status... from the pop-
   up menu.
- `E5.S15`: Platforms affected:
   All Distributed (iSeries, all Unix and Windows)
   ****************************************************************
   PROBLEM SUMMARY:
   Applications that connect to WebSphere MQ using the CLIENT
   transport provide version information to the queue manager
   about the level of WebSphere MQ Client code that the
   application is running. This version information is in the
   format:
- `E5.S16`: VVRRMMFF
- `E5.S17`: where:
- `E5.S18`: - VV = Version
   - RR = Release
   - MM = Maintenance level
   - FF = Fix level
- `E5.S19`: The runmqsc command:
- `E5.S20`: DISPLAY CHSTATUS(channel name)
- `E5.S21`: will report this version information in the RVERSION attribute.
- `E5.S22`: The WebSphere MQ Explorer shows the version information in the:
- `E5.S23`: Remote Version
- `E5.S24`: column in the Channel Status window.
- `E5.S25`: In order to determine the version information to pass to a
   queue manager, the WebSphere MQ V7.0.1 classes for Java and
   classes for JMS, and the WebSphere MQ V7.0.1 Resource Adapter,
   looked inside the MANIFEST.MF file contained within the file:
- `E5.S26`: com.ibm.mq.jmqi.jar
- `E5.S27`: for the property:
- `E5.S28`: version
- `E5.S29`: However, the MANIFEST.MF file did not contain an entry for this
   property. This caused the WebSphere MQ classes for Java and
   classes for JMS, and the WebSphere MQ Resource Adapter,to
   specify:
- `E5.S30`: 00000000
- `E5.S31`: as the version number being used.
- `E5.S32`: PROBLEM CONCLUSION
 *  The WebSphere MQ V7.0.1 classes for Java and classes for JMS,
   and the WebSphere MQ V7.0.1 Resource Adapter, have been updated
   to use the information in the property:
- `E5.S33`: com.ibm.mq.jmqi
- `E5.S34`: within the MANIFEST.MF file contained within the JAR file:
- `E5.S35`: com.ibm.mq.jmqi.jar
- `E5.S36`: to determine what version information to pass to the queue
   manager.
- `E5.S37`: Applications using the WebSphere MQ Resource Adapter or Java
   and JMS clients which have this APAR applied will report
   their version information correctly to the queue manager,
   which will be reflected in the information returned by
   runmqsc and the MQ Explorer.

Status: `ANSWER`

Visible answer:
On PureApplication System 2.1.2.0, 2.2.0.0, and later, the affected pattern types can install only MQ 8.0.0.2; later versions such as 8.0.0.4 cannot be installed, and maintenance cannot be applied to running pattern instances. [E1.S6]

The documented resolution is to obtain and install the updated maintenance.py lifecycle script, which enables installation or migration to the latest MQ maintenance level contained in the pattern type. The update and installation steps are available from IBM Fix Central; APAR IT15252 was raised for this issue. [E1.S7] [E1.S8] [E1.S10]

## techqa_DEV_Q166#row-0119

Question:
Which version of the WebSphere MQ Resource Adapter is shipped with  WebSphere Application Server? Which version of WebSphere MQ JCA resource adapter is shipped with WebSphere Application Server ? 

Reference / gold answer:
WebSphere Application Server Version 7 ships with the WebSphere MQ 7.0 Resource Adapter.
- WAS 7.0.0.27 - WMQ 7.0.1.9

WebSphere Application Server Version 8 ships with the WebSphere MQ 7.0 Resource Adapter.
- WAS 8.0.0.5 - WMQ 7.0.1.9

WebSphere Application Server Version 8.5 ships with the WebSphere MQ 7.1 Resource Adapter.
- WAS 8.5.0.2 - WMQ 7.1.0.2

Reference evidence:
- `2ac`: WebSphere Application Server Version 8.5 ships with the WebSphere MQ 7.1 Resource Adapter.
- `2ad`: - WAS 8.5.0.2 - WMQ 7.1.0.2 - This level includes APAR IV14093
- `2ae`: - WAS 8.5.0.1 - WMQ 7.1.0.1
- `2ag`: WebSphere Application Server Version 8 ships with the WebSphere MQ 7.0 Resource Adapter.
- `2ah`: - WAS 8.0.0.5 - WMQ 7.0.1.9 - This level includes APAR IV14093
- `2ai`: - WAS 8.0.0.4 - WMQ 7.0.1.7
- `2aj`: - WAS 8.0.0.3 - WMQ 7.0.1.7
- `2ak`: - WAS 8.0.0.2 - WMQ 7.0.1.6
- `2al`: - WAS 8.0.0.1 - WMQ 7.0.1.5
- `2am`: WebSphere Application Server Version 7 ships with the WebSphere MQ 7.0 Resource Adapter.
- `2an`: - WAS 7.0.0.27 - WMQ 7.0.1.9 - This level includes APAR IV14093
- `2ao`: - WAS 7.0.0.25 - WMQ 7.0.1.7
- `2ap`: - WAS 7.0.0.23 - WMQ 7.0.1.7
- `2aq`: - WAS 7.0.0.21 - WMQ 7.0.1.6
- `2ar`: - WAS 7.0.0.19 - WMQ 7.0.1.5
- `3f`: The WebSphere MQ messaging provider in WebSphere Application Server Version 7 and Version 8 includes a version of the WebSphere MQ resource adapter.
- `3g`: The version of the resource adapter supplied with the Application Server should be used in these environment.

=== CANDIDATE A ===

- `E2.S1`: PRODUCT DOCUMENTATION
- `E2.S2`: ABSTRACT
 This document contains the statement of support for the WebSphere MQ resource adapter provided with WebSphere MQ V7.1 and later.
- `E2.S3`: CONTENT
WebSphere MQ V7.1 and later includes a J2EE Connector Architecture (JCA) V1.5 resource adapter. The resource adapter implements the JCA V1.5 interfaces and can be used in J2EE 1.4 (or later) compliant application servers to access the resources of a WebSphere MQ queue manager.
- `E2.S4`: Using the resource adapter with WebSphere Application Server Version 7 and Version 8
The WebSphere MQ messaging provider in WebSphere Application Server Version 7 and Version 8 includes a version of the WebSphere MQ resource adapter. The version of the resource adapter supplied with the Application Server should be used in these environment.
- `E2.S5`: Updates to the WebSphere MQ resource adapter that is installed with the application server are included in WebSphere Application Server Fix Packs.
- `E2.S6`: For more details please see:
- `E2.S7`: Information about using the WebSphere MQ messaging provider for WebSphere Application Server Version 7.0 [http://publib.boulder.ibm.com/infocenter/prodconn/v1r0m0/topic/com.ibm.scenarios.wmqwasusing.doc/topics/swg21316899.htm]
- `E2.S8`: Information about using the WebSphere MQ messaging provider for WebSphere Application Server Version 8.0 [http://publib.boulder.ibm.com/infocenter/prodconn/v1r0m0/topic/com.ibm.scenarios.wmqwasusing.doc/topics/swg21498708.htm]
[http://publib.boulder.ibm.com/infocenter/prodconn/v1r0m0/topic/com.ibm.scenarios.wmqwasusing.doc/topics/swg21498708.htm]
Information about using the WebSphere MQ messaging provider for WebSphere Application Server Version 8.5 [http://publib.boulder.ibm.com/infocenter/prodconn/v1r0m0/topic/com.ibm.scenarios.wmqwasusing.doc/topics/swg21498708_85.htm]
- `E2.S9`: Identifying which WebSphere MQ client is shipped with WebSphere Application Server [http://publib.boulder.ibm.com/infocenter/prodconn/v1r0m0/topic/com.ibm.scenarios.wmqwasusing.doc/topics/swg21248089.htm]
- `E2.S10`: Using the resource adapter with WebSphere Application Server Version 6.1
The resource adapter must not be used with WebSphere Application Server Version 6.1. To access the resources of a WebSphere MQ queue manager from within WebSphere Application Server, use the WebSphere MQ messaging provider. [http://publib.boulder.ibm.com/infocenter/prodconn/v1r0m0/topic/com.ibm.scenarios.wmqwasusing.doc/topics/swg21307203.htm]
Information about using WebSphere MQ as the JMS Provider for WebSphere Application Server Version 6.1 [http://publib.boulder.ibm.com/infocenter/prodconn/v1r0m0/topic/com.ibm.scenarios.wmqwasusing.doc/topics/swg21307203.htm]
- `E2.S11`: Using the resource adapter with other application servers
For all other J2EE 1.4 (or later) compliant application servers, problems following successful completion of the WebSphere MQ resource adapter Installation Verification Test (IVT) can be reported to IBM for the investigation of WebSphere MQ product trace and other WebSphere MQ diagnostic information. If the WebSphere MQ resource adapter IVT cannot be run successfully, problems encountered are likely to be caused by incorrect deployment or incorrect resource definitions which are application server specific and the problems should be investigated using application server documentation and / or the support organization for that application server.
- `E2.S12`: IBM has tested the resource adapter on the application servers listed below
- `E2.S13`: * WebSphere Application Server Community Edition V2.1.1.5 
 * JBoss Application Server V6.0.0
- `E2.S14`: Example scripts and detailed instructions for running the IVT with JBoss V6.0.0 and WAS CE V2.1.1.5 can be found in the WebSphere MQ 7.1 and V7.5 Information Centers.
- `E2.S15`: General issues
- `E2.S16`: Session interleaving is not supported: 
Some application servers provide a capability called session interleaving, where the same JMS session can be used in multiple transactions, although it is only enlisted in one at a time. This is not supported by the WebSphere MQ resource adapter, and can lead to the issues shown below: 
 * An attempt to put a message to a WebSphere MQ queue fails with reason code 2072 (MQRC_SYNCPOINT_NOT_AVAILABLE). 
 * Calls to xa_close() fail with reason code -3 (XAER_PROTO), and an FDC with probe ID AT040010 is generated on the WebSphere MQ queue manager being accessed from the application server.
- `E2.S17`: only enlisted in one at a time. This is not supported by the WebSphere MQ resource adapter, and can lead to the issues shown below: 
 * An attempt to put a message to a WebSphere MQ queue fails with reason code 2072 (MQRC_SYNCPOINT_NOT_AVAILABLE). 
 * Calls to xa_close() fail with reason code -3 (XAER_PROTO), and an FDC with probe ID AT040010 is generated on the WebSphere MQ queue manager being accessed from the application server.
- `E2.S18`: Please see your application server documentation for how to disable this capability.
- `E2.S19`: Java™ Transaction API (JTA) Specification of how XA resources are recovered for XA transaction recovery: 
Section 3.4.8 of the JTA specification does not define a specific mechanism by which XA resources are recreated to perform XA transactional recovery. As such, it is up to each individual transaction manager (and therefore application server) how XA resources involved in an XA transaction are recovered. It is possible that, for some application servers, the WebSphere MQ resource adapter does not implement the application server specific mechanism utilized to perform XA transactional recovery.
- `E2.S20`: IBM has tested XA transactional recovery with the WebSphere MQ 7.1 resource adapter on the following application servers: 
 * WebSphere Application Server V7.0, V8.0 and V8.5. 
 * WebSphere Application Server Community Edition V2.1.1.5 
 * JBoss Application Server V6.0.0

- `E2.S1`: PRODUCT DOCUMENTATION
- `E2.S2`: ABSTRACT
 This document contains the statement of support for the WebSphere MQ resource adapter provided with WebSphere MQ V7.1 and later.
- `E2.S3`: CONTENT
WebSphere MQ V7.1 and later includes a J2EE Connector Architecture (JCA) V1.5 resource adapter. The resource adapter implements the JCA V1.5 interfaces and can be used in J2EE 1.4 (or later) compliant application servers to access the resources of a WebSphere MQ queue manager.
- `E2.S4`: Using the resource adapter with WebSphere Application Server Version 7 and Version 8
The WebSphere MQ messaging provider in WebSphere Application Server Version 7 and Version 8 includes a version of the WebSphere MQ resource adapter. The version of the resource adapter supplied with the Application Server should be used in these environment.
- `E2.S5`: Updates to the WebSphere MQ resource adapter that is installed with the application server are included in WebSphere Application Server Fix Packs.
- `E2.S6`: For more details please see:
- `E2.S7`: Information about using the WebSphere MQ messaging provider for WebSphere Application Server Version 7.0 [http://publib.boulder.ibm.com/infocenter/prodconn/v1r0m0/topic/com.ibm.scenarios.wmqwasusing.doc/topics/swg21316899.htm]
- `E2.S8`: Information about using the WebSphere MQ messaging provider for WebSphere Application Server Version 8.0 [http://publib.boulder.ibm.com/infocenter/prodconn/v1r0m0/topic/com.ibm.scenarios.wmqwasusing.doc/topics/swg21498708.htm]
[http://publib.boulder.ibm.com/infocenter/prodconn/v1r0m0/topic/com.ibm.scenarios.wmqwasusing.doc/topics/swg21498708.htm]
Information about using the WebSphere MQ messaging provider for WebSphere Application Server Version 8.5 [http://publib.boulder.ibm.com/infocenter/prodconn/v1r0m0/topic/com.ibm.scenarios.wmqwasusing.doc/topics/swg21498708_85.htm]
- `E2.S9`: Identifying which WebSphere MQ client is shipped with WebSphere Application Server [http://publib.boulder.ibm.com/infocenter/prodconn/v1r0m0/topic/com.ibm.scenarios.wmqwasusing.doc/topics/swg21248089.htm]
- `E2.S10`: Using the resource adapter with WebSphere Application Server Version 6.1
The resource adapter must not be used with WebSphere Application Server Version 6.1. To access the resources of a WebSphere MQ queue manager from within WebSphere Application Server, use the WebSphere MQ messaging provider. [http://publib.boulder.ibm.com/infocenter/prodconn/v1r0m0/topic/com.ibm.scenarios.wmqwasusing.doc/topics/swg21307203.htm]
Information about using WebSphere MQ as the JMS Provider for WebSphere Application Server Version 6.1 [http://publib.boulder.ibm.com/infocenter/prodconn/v1r0m0/topic/com.ibm.scenarios.wmqwasusing.doc/topics/swg21307203.htm]
- `E2.S11`: Using the resource adapter with other application servers
For all other J2EE 1.4 (or later) compliant application servers, problems following successful completion of the WebSphere MQ resource adapter Installation Verification Test (IVT) can be reported to IBM for the investigation of WebSphere MQ product trace and other WebSphere MQ diagnostic information. If the WebSphere MQ resource adapter IVT cannot be run successfully, problems encountered are likely to be caused by incorrect deployment or incorrect resource definitions which are application server specific and the problems should be investigated using application server documentation and / or the support organization for that application server.
- `E2.S12`: IBM has tested the resource adapter on the application servers listed below
- `E2.S13`: * WebSphere Application Server Community Edition V2.1.1.5 
 * JBoss Application Server V6.0.0
- `E2.S14`: Example scripts and detailed instructions for running the IVT with JBoss V6.0.0 and WAS CE V2.1.1.5 can be found in the WebSphere MQ 7.1 and V7.5 Information Centers.
- `E2.S15`: General issues
- `E2.S16`: Session interleaving is not supported: 
Some application servers provide a capability called session interleaving, where the same JMS session can be used in multiple transactions, although it is only enlisted in one at a time. This is not supported by the WebSphere MQ resource adapter, and can lead to the issues shown below: 
 * An attempt to put a message to a WebSphere MQ queue fails with reason code 2072 (MQRC_SYNCPOINT_NOT_AVAILABLE). 
 * Calls to xa_close() fail with reason code -3 (XAER_PROTO), and an FDC with probe ID AT040010 is generated on the WebSphere MQ queue manager being accessed from the application server.
- `E2.S17`: only enlisted in one at a time. This is not supported by the WebSphere MQ resource adapter, and can lead to the issues shown below: 
 * An attempt to put a message to a WebSphere MQ queue fails with reason code 2072 (MQRC_SYNCPOINT_NOT_AVAILABLE). 
 * Calls to xa_close() fail with reason code -3 (XAER_PROTO), and an FDC with probe ID AT040010 is generated on the WebSphere MQ queue manager being accessed from the application server.
- `E2.S18`: Please see your application server documentation for how to disable this capability.
- `E2.S19`: Java™ Transaction API (JTA) Specification of how XA resources are recovered for XA transaction recovery: 
Section 3.4.8 of the JTA specification does not define a specific mechanism by which XA resources are recreated to perform XA transactional recovery. As such, it is up to each individual transaction manager (and therefore application server) how XA resources involved in an XA transaction are recovered. It is possible that, for some application servers, the WebSphere MQ resource adapter does not implement the application server specific mechanism utilized to perform XA transactional recovery.
- `E2.S20`: IBM has tested XA transactional recovery with the WebSphere MQ 7.1 resource adapter on the following application servers: 
 * WebSphere Application Server V7.0, V8.0 and V8.5. 
 * WebSphere Application Server Community Edition V2.1.1.5 
 * JBoss Application Server V6.0.0

- `E5.S1`: TECHNOTE (TROUBLESHOOTING)
- `E5.S2`: PROBLEM(ABSTRACT)
 While running WebSphere Application Server under a heavy load, it can throw OutOfMemoryError (OOM) when the heap is fully exhausted and produce a heapdump and javacore. If the heapdump shows a large number of com.ibm.jsse2.SSLSocketImpl objects as a leak suspect, this might be caused by an APAR with WebSphere MQ which blocks Finalizer thread from garbage collection.
- `E5.S3`: CAUSE
WebSphere MQ (WMQ) Resource Adapter, shipped with WebSphere Application Server, had a defect which blocked the finalizer thread while closing a ServerSession object. This would then block the garbage collection of all objects with a finalize method, leading to OutOfMemory events. The largest heap user might be com.ibm.jsse2.SSLSocketImpl objects. This problem was fixed under WMQ APAR IV14093 which shipped with certain levels of WebSphere Application Server Fix Packs.
- `E5.S4`: ENVIRONMENT
WebSphere Application Server V7.0, V8,0, V8.5
- `E5.S5`: DIAGNOSING THE PROBLEM
Collect a heapdump and javacore from an OOM event. Use Memory Analyzer or IBM HeapAnalyzer for heapdump analysis. You might see "com.ibm.jsse2.SSLSocketImpl" as a leak suspect.
- `E5.S6`: (For example)
16,985 instances of "com.ibm.jsse2.SSLSocketImpl" 594,807,720 (59.86%) byte
- `E5.S7`: If corresponding javacore shows a Finalizer thread is waiting on "com/ibm/mq/connector/inbound/ServerSessionImpl$IsInUseLock", the root cause is most likely WMQ APAR IV14093.
- `E5.S8`: (For example)
"Finalizer thread" 
Waiting on: com/ibm/mq/connector/inbound/ServerSessionImpl$IsInUseLock@0x976F7DE0 Owned by: <unowned>
Java callstack:

Status: `ANSWER`

Visible answer:
WebSphere Application Server V8.5 ships with the WebSphere MQ 7.1 Resource Adapter. Specifically, WAS 8.5.0.0 shipped WMQ 7.1.0.0, WAS 8.5.0.1 shipped WMQ 7.1.0.1, and WAS 8.5.0.2 shipped WMQ 7.1.0.2. [E5.S16]

WebSphere Application Server V8 and V7 ship with the WebSphere MQ 7.0 Resource Adapter. For example, WAS 8.0.0.2 shipped WMQ 7.0.1.6, WAS 8.0.0.5 shipped WMQ 7.0.1.9, WAS 7.0.0.21 shipped WMQ 7.0.1.6, and WAS 7.0.0.27 shipped WMQ 7.0.1.9. [E5.S17] [E5.S18]

For WebSphere Application Server V8.5.5, the shipped WebSphere MQ JCA Resource Adapter was updated to version 7.1.0.7 with the fix for WMQ-RA APAR IT15559; the resulting RAR implementation version is 7.1.0.7-k710-007-151026_IT15559. [E1.S4] [E1.S7]

- `E5.S1`: SECURITY BULLETIN
- `E5.S2`: SUMMARY
 Vulnerabilities in .NET Core, ASP.NET Core Could Allow Elevation of Privilege. Vulnerabilities in Node.js and the c-ares library were disclosed on July 11 2017 by the Node.js Foundation. IBM SDK for Node.js has addressed the applicable CVEs.
- `E5.S3`: VULNERABILITY DETAILS
CVEID: CVE-2017-0256 [http://cve.mitre.org/cgi-bin/cvename.cgi?name=CVE-2017-0256]
DESCRIPTION: Microsoft ASP.NET Core could allow a remote attacker to conduct spoofing attacks, caused by improper validation of user supplied input.
CVSS Base Score: 6.5
CVSS Temporal Score: See https://exchange.xforce.ibmcloud.com/vulnerabilities/125327 [https://exchange.xforce.ibmcloud.com/vulnerabilities/125327] for the current score
CVSS Environmental Score*: Undefined
CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.0/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:N)
- `E5.S4`: CVEID: CVE-2017-0249 [http://cve.mitre.org/cgi-bin/cvename.cgi?name=CVE-2017-0249]
DESCRIPTION: Microsoft ASP.NET Core could allow a remote attacker to gain elevated privileges on the system, caused by improper validation of user supplied input.
CVSS Base Score: 8.4
CVSS Temporal Score: See https://exchange.xforce.ibmcloud.com/vulnerabilities/125299 [https://exchange.xforce.ibmcloud.com/vulnerabilities/125299] for the current score
CVSS Environmental Score*: Undefined
CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.0/AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H)
- `E5.S5`: CVEID: CVE-2017-0247 [http://cve.mitre.org/cgi-bin/cvename.cgi?name=CVE-2017-0247]
DESCRIPTION: Microsoft ASP.NET Core is vulnerable to a denial of service, caused by improper validation of web requests in the TextEncoder.EncodeCore function. By inserting specially-crafted content into any system using the function to encode content, a remote attacker could exploit this vulnerability to prevent any page delivering the content from loading.
CVSS Base Score: 3.6
CVSS Temporal Score: See https://exchange.xforce.ibmcloud.com/vulnerabilities/125297 [https://exchange.xforce.ibmcloud.com/vulnerabilities/125297] for the current score
CVSS Environmental Score*: Undefined
CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.0/AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:C/C:N/I:N/A:L)
- `E5.S6`: CVEID: CVE-2017-1000381 [http://cve.mitre.org/cgi-bin/cvename.cgi?name=CVE-2017-1000381]
DESCRIPTION: c-ares could allow a remote attacker to obtain sensitive information, caused by an out-of-bounds read in the ares_parse_naptr_reply() function when parsing NAPTR responses. By sending specially crafted DNS response packet, an attacker could exploit this vulnerability to read memory outside of the given input buffer and cause a denial of service.
CVSS Base Score: 6.5
CVSS Temporal Score: See https://exchange.xforce.ibmcloud.com/vulnerabilities/128625 [https://exchange.xforce.ibmcloud.com/vulnerabilities/128625] for the current score
CVSS Environmental Score*: Undefined
CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.0/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:L)
- `E5.S7`: CVEID: CVE-2017-11499 [http://cve.mitre.org/cgi-bin/cvename.cgi?name=CVE-2017-11499]
DESCRIPTION: Node.js is vulnerable to a denial of service, caused by a flaw related to constant HashTable seeds. A remote attacker could exploit this vulnerability to flood the hash and cause a denial of service.
CVSS Base Score: 7.5
CVSS Temporal Score: See https://exchange.xforce.ibmcloud.com/vulnerabilities/129465 [https://exchange.xforce.ibmcloud.com/vulnerabilities/129465] for the current score
CVSS Environmental Score*: Undefined
CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.0/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H)
- `E5.S8`: AFFECTED PRODUCTS AND VERSIONS
These vulnerabilities affect ASP.NET Core in IBM Bluemix v1.0.20 and earlier releases.
- `E5.S9`: You can also find this file through the command-line Cloud Foundry client by running the following command:
- `E5.S10`: cf ssh <appname> -c cat staging_info.yml
- `E5.S11`: Look for the following lines:
{"detected_buildpack":"ASP.NET Core (buildpack-v1.xxx)","start_command":"cd . \u0026\u0026 dotnet dotnetstarter.dll --server.urls http://0.0.0.0:${PORT}" [http://0.0.0.0:$%7Bport%7D'/]}
- `E5.S12`: If the buildpack version is not at least v1.0.22 your application may be vulnerable.
- `E5.S13`: REMEDIATION/FIXES
You will need to restage (or re-push) your application using the ASP.NET Core Buildpack v1.0.22.
- `E5.S14`: WORKAROUNDS AND MITIGATIONS
None.
- `E5.S15`: ADDITIONAL BLUEMIX ALERT INFORMATION
Monitor the Bluemix console (https://console.ng.bluemix.net/status/ [https://console.ng.bluemix.net/status/]) for additional important product alerts.

Model-visible evidence:
- `E1.S1`: SECURITY BULLETIN
- `E1.S2`: SUMMARY
 IBM API Connect has addressed the following vulnerability.
- `E1.S3`: Node.js is vulnerable to a denial of service, caused by an uncaught exception flaw in the zlib module. By making 8 an invalid value for the windowBits parameter, a remote attacker could exploit this vulnerability to cause the application to crash.
- `E1.S4`: VULNERABILITY DETAILS
CVEID:CVE-2017-14919 [http://cve.mitre.org/cgi-bin/cvename.cgi?name=CVE-2017-14919]
DESCRIPTION:Node.js is vulnerable to a denial of service, caused by an uncaught exception flaw in the zlib module. By making 8 an invalid value for the windowBits parameter, a remote attacker could exploit this vulnerability to cause the application to crash.
CVSS Base Score: 7.5
CVSS Temporal Score: Seehttps://exchange.xforce.ibmcloud.com/vulnerabilities/134286 [https://exchange.xforce.ibmcloud.com/vulnerabilities/134286]for the current score

- `E2.S1`: SECURITY BULLETIN
- `E2.S2`: SUMMARY
 OpenSSL vulnerabilities were disclosed on December 7, 2017 by the OpenSSL Project. OpenSSL is used by IBM SDK for Node.js. IBM SDK for Node.js has addressed the applicable CVEs.
- `E2.S3`: VULNERABILITY DETAILS
CVEID:CVE-2017-3737 [http://cve.mitre.org/cgi-bin/cvename.cgi?name=CVE-2017-3737]
DESCRIPTION:OpenSSL could allow a remote attacker to bypass security restrictions, caused by a flaw in the \"error state\" mechanism when directly calling SSL_read() or SSL_write() for an SSL object after receiving a fatal error. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability to bypass the decryption or encryption process and perform unauthorized actions.
CVSS Base Score: 5.3
CVSS Temporal Score: Seehttps://exchange.xforce.ibmcloud.com/vulnerabilities/136077 [https://exchange.xforce.ibmcloud.com/vulnerabilities/136077]for more information
CVSS Environmental Score*: Undefined
CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.0/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:L/A:N)
- `E2.S4`: CVEID: CVE-2017-3738 [http://cve.mitre.org/cgi-bin/cvename.cgi?name=CVE-2017-3738]
DESCRIPTION:OpenSSL could allow a remote attacker to obtain sensitive information, caused by an overflow bug in the AVX2 Montgomery multiplication procedure used in exponentiation with 1024-bit moduli. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability to obtain information about the private key. Note: In order to exploit this vulnerability, the server would have to share the DH1024 private key among multiple clients, which is no longer an option since CVE-2016-0701.
CVSS Base Score: 3.1
CVSS Temporal Score: Seehttps://exchange.xforce.ibmcloud.com/vulnerabilities/136078 [https://exchange.xforce.ibmcloud.com/vulnerabilities/136078]for more information
CVSS Environmental Score*: Undefined
CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.0/AV:N/AC:H/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:N)
- `E2.S5`: AFFECTED PRODUCTS AND VERSIONS
These vulnerabilities affect IBM SDK for Node.js v4.8.6.0 and earlier releases.
These vulnerabilities affect IBM SDK for Node.js v6.12.0.0 and earlier releases.
These vulnerabilities affect IBM SDK for Node.js v8.9.0.0 and earlier releases.
- `E2.S6`: REMEDIATION/FIXES
The fixes for these vulnerabilities are included in IBM SDK for Node.js v4.8.7.0 and subsequent releases.
The fixes for these vulnerabilities are included in IBM SDK for Node.js v6.12.2.0 and subsequent releases.
The fixes for these vulnerabilities are included in IBM SDK for Node.js v8.9.3.0 and subsequent releases.

- `E3.S1`: SECURITY BULLETIN
- `E3.S2`: SUMMARY
 Denial of service vulnerability in module semver, used by the npm package management tool
- `E3.S3`: VULNERABILITY DETAILS
CVEID:CVE-2015-8855 [http://cve.mitre.org/cgi-bin/cvename.cgi?name=CVE-2015-8855]
DESCRIPTION:The Node.js semver module is vulnerable to a denial of service, caused by an error in the regular expression implementation. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability using a regular expression to cause the application to hang.
CVSS Base Score: 5
CVSS Temporal Score: Seehttps://exchange.xforce.ibmcloud.com/vulnerabilities/112562 [https://exchange.xforce.ibmcloud.com/vulnerabilities/112562]for the current score
CVSS Environmental Score*: Undefined
CVSS Vector: (AV:N/AC:L/Au:N/C:N/I:N/A:P)
- `E3.S4`: The semver module included in IBM SDK for Node.js is a bundled dependency of the Node Package Manager (npm). This module instance is not normally exposed to end users of IBM SDK for Node.js.
- `E3.S5`: AFFECTED PRODUCTS AND VERSIONS
These vulnerabilities affect IBM SDK for Node.js v1.1.0.20 and previous releases.
These vulnerabilities affect IBM SDK for Node.js v1.2.0.1 and previous releases.
- `E3.S6`: REMEDIATION/FIXES
The fixes for these vulnerabilities are included in IBM SDK for Node.js v1.1.1.0 and subsequent releases.
The fixes for these vulnerabilities are included in IBM SDK for Node.js v1.2.0.2 and subsequent releases.
- `E3.S7`: IBM SDK for Node.js can be downloaded, subject to the terms of the developerWorks license, from here [http://www.ibm.com/developerworks/web/nodesdk/].
- `E3.S8`: IBM customers requiring an update for an SDK shipped with an IBM product should contact IBM support [http://www.ibm.com/support/], and/or refer to the appropriate product security bulletin.

- `E4.S1`: SECURITY BULLETIN
- `E4.S2`: SUMMARY
 Two ReDoS vulnerabilities in modules included in the Node.js npm tool shipped by IBM Rational Application Developer for WebSphere Software.
- `E4.S3`: VULNERABILITY DETAILS
CVEID: CVE-2016-2515 [http://cve.mitre.org/cgi-bin/cvename.cgi?name=CVE-2016-2515]
DESCRIPTION: Node.JS hawk is vulnerable to a denial of service, caused by an error in the regular expression implementation. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability using an overly long header or URI to cause the application to hang.
CVSS Base Score: 5.3
CVSS Temporal Score: See https://exchange.xforce.ibmcloud.com/vulnerabilities/110819 [https://exchange.xforce.ibmcloud.com/vulnerabilities/110819] for the current score
CVSS Environmental Score*: Undefined
CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.0/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:L)
- `E4.S4`: CVEID: CVE-2016-2537 [http://cve.mitre.org/cgi-bin/cvename.cgi?name=CVE-2016-2537]
DESCRIPTION: Node.js is vulnerable to a denial of service, caused by an error in the regular expression implementation. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability using a regular expression to block the event loop and cause the application to hang.
CVSS Base Score: 5.3
CVSS Temporal Score: See https://exchange.xforce.ibmcloud.com/vulnerabilities/110870 [https://exchange.xforce.ibmcloud.com/vulnerabilities/110870] for the current score
CVSS Environmental Score*: Undefined
CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.0/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:L)
- `E4.S5`: AFFECTED PRODUCTS AND VERSIONS
IBM Rational Application Developer for WebSphere Software v9.1 and v9.5
- `E4.S6`: REMEDIATION/FIXES
- `E4.S7`: Rational Application Developer 9.1.x and 9.5.x PI60929  * Apply IBM SDK for Node.js Version 1.1 release updated equivalent to the Joyent Node.js API version 0.10.44 [https://developer.ibm.com/node/sdk/#v11] to the Cordova platform in the product.
- `E4.S8`: Installation instructions for applying the update to the Cordova platform in the product can be found here:
- `E4.S9`: Upgrading the IBM SDK for Node.js used by Cordova [http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21684946]

- `E5.S1`: SECURITY BULLETIN
- `E5.S2`: SUMMARY
 OpenSSL vulnerabilities were disclosed on November 2, 2017 by the OpenSSL Project. OpenSSL is used by IBM SDK for Node.js. IBM SDK for Node.js has addressed the applicable CVEs.
- `E5.S3`: VULNERABILITY DETAILS
CVEID:CVE-2017-3735 [http://cve.mitre.org/cgi-bin/cvename.cgi?name=CVE-2017-3735]
Description:OpenSSL could allow a remote attacker to obtain sensitive information, caused by an error while parsing an IPAdressFamily extension in an X.509 certificate. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability to trigger an out-of-bounds read, resulting in an incorrect text display of the certificate.
CVSS Base Score: 4.3
CVSS Temporal Score:https://exchange.xforce.ibmcloud.com/vulnerabilities/131047 [https://exchange.xforce.ibmcloud.com/vulnerabilities/131047] for more information
CVSS Environmental Score*: Undefined
CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.0/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:N)
- `E5.S4`: CVEID: CVE-2017-3736 [http://cve.mitre.org/cgi-bin/cvename.cgi?name=CVE-2017-3736]
DESCRIPTION: OpenSSL could allow a remote attacker to obtain sensitive information, caused by a carry propagation flaw in the the x86_64 Montgomery squaring function bn_sqrx8x_internal(). An attacker with online access to an unpatched system could exploit this vulnerability to obtain information about the private key.
CVSS Base Score: 5.9
CVSS Temporal Score: See https://exchange.xforce.ibmcloud.com/vulnerabilities/134397 [https://exchange.xforce.ibmcloud.com/vulnerabilities/134397] for more information
CVSS Environmental Score*: Undefined
CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.0/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N)
- `E5.S5`: AFFECTED PRODUCTS AND VERSIONS
These vulnerabilities affect IBM SDK for Node.js v4.8.5.0 and earlier releases.
These vulnerabilities affect IBM SDK for Node.js v6.11.5.0 and earlier releases.
These vulnerabilities affect IBM SDK for Node.js v8.9.0.0 and earlier releases.
- `E5.S6`: REMEDIATION/FIXES
The fixes for these vulnerabilities are included in IBM SDK for Node.js v4.8.6.0 and subsequent releases.
The fixes for these vulnerabilities are included in IBM SDK for Node.js v6.12.0.0 and subsequent releases.
The fixes for these vulnerabilities are included in IBM SDK for Node.js v8.9.3.0 and subsequent releases.
- `E5.S7`: IBM SDK for Node.js can be downloaded, subject to the terms of the developerWorks license, fromhere [http://www.ibm.com/developerworks/web/nodesdk/].
- `E5.S8`: IBM customers requiring an update for an SDK shipped with an IBM product should contactIBM support [http://www.ibm.com/support/], and/or refer to the appropriate product security bulletin.

Status: `ANSWER`

Visible answer:
The information is in the IBM API Connect Security Bulletin, particularly its “Vulnerability Details” section for CVE-2017-14919. The vulnerability is a Node.js zlib uncaught-exception flaw that can let a remote attacker crash the application by using an invalid windowBits value of 8. Its CVSS base score is 7.5. [E1.S2] [E1.S3] [E1.S4]

For remediation, IBM API Connect 5.0.0.0–5.0.6.4 is addressed in version 5.0.6.5 under APAR LI79994. [E1.S7] [E1.S8]

IBM API Connect 5.0.7.0–5.0.7.2 and 5.0.8.0–5.0.8.1 are addressed in version 5.0.8.2 under APAR LI79994. [E1.S11] [E1.S14]

Fixes can be obtained through IBM Fix Central: for the 5.0.6.4 release, use https://www-945.ibm.com/support/fixcentral/swg/selectFixes?parent=ibm%7EWebSphere&product=ibm/WebSphere/IBM+API+Connect&release=5.0.6.4&platform=All&function=all and find the “APIConnect-Portal” package. [E1.S9] [E1.S10]

For the 5.0.8.1 release, use https://www-945.ibm.com/support/fixcentral/swg/selectFixes?parent=ibm%7EWebSphere&product=ibm/WebSphere/IBM+API+Connect&release=5.0.8.1&platform=All&function=all and find the “APIConnect_Management” and “APIConnect-Portal” packages. [E1.S12] [E1.S13] [E1.S15] [E1.S16]

Additional bulletin information is available through IBM’s Secure Engineering Web Portal and Product Security Incident Response Blog. [E1.S18]

## techqa_DEV_Q181#row-0079

Question:
Get all data that\'s registred today Version: 
MxLoader 4.7.4
                        

Problem:
Is it possible to do something like this:
reportdate >= TODAY()?

I cant get it to work but i would like to get all the data that has been registred today today.  


Reference / gold answer:
Based on the provided context, the information related to the registration date of data is not explicitly mentioned. The context mainly discusses technical issues, solutions, and updates related to Maximo, DB2, Oracle, Lotus Notes, and other software components. The context also includes APAR (Authorized Program Analysis Report) details, error descriptions, and temporary fixes for various reported issues.

To determine the data that has been registered today, it would be necessary to access the specific database or application where the data is stored and use appropriate query syntax to filter the data based on the registration date. The concept of `TODAY()` may or may not be directly applicable depending on the database technology and schema used for storing the data.

If you are working with Maximo, you may need to refer to the Maximo documentation or consult with the system administrators or developers familiar with the specific configuration and customization of Maximo in your environment to accurately retrieve the data that has been registered today.

 *  ****************************************************************
   * USERS AFFECTED:                                              *
   * Maximo users of PM work order generation                     *
   ****************************************************************
   * PROBLEM DESCRIPTION:                                         *
   * PMs are generating with milliseconds on the targstartdate    *
   * and targcompdate fields on Work Orders. This causes a        *
   * problem searching using the calendar control in Work Order   *
   * Tracking.                                                    *
   ****************************************************************
   * RECOMMENDATION:                                              *
   * Apply latest fix pack.                                       *
   ****************************************************************
   Steps to replicate:
- `E4.S17`: 1 Create a PM Record
   2 Fill in the Work Type and Location
   3 On the Frequency Tab enter 1 Day and the Estimated Due Date
   for today 02/12/14
   4 Save
   5 On the Seasonal Dates  tab I have 12:00 AM for the
   PM.TARGSTARTTIME ( default in the Database)
   6 Change status to Active
   7 Generate Workorder
   8 Go to the Workorder Application
   9 Go to Advanced Search Dialog and fill in Target Start field
   and Target Finish 2/12/14 12:00 AM for both FROM and TO.
   10 Click Find
- `E4.S18`: You will get the following System Message:
      BMXAA4186E - No records were found that match the specified
   query. Check that the value you are searching for was entered
   correctly
- `E4.S19`: 11 Note the Where Clause accessed by the dropdown arrow to the
   right of the Advanced Search button:
   (targcompdate >= { ts '2014-02-12 00:00:00.000' } and
   targstartdate <={ ts '2014-02-12 00:00:00.000' } and siteid =
   'BEDFORD' and
   targstartdate >= { ts '2014-02-12 00:00:00.000' } and
   targcompdate <= {ts '2014-02-12 00:00:00.000' } and wonum like
   '%1205%')
   ------------------------------------
   Because Target Start on the PM is set to midnight (without any
   milliseconds), the PM WOGEN process shouldn't include
   millseconds when it sets
   the target start/target finish otherwise searches like this will
   fail.
- `E4.S20`: 11 Note the Where Clause accessed by the dropdown arrow to the
   right of the Advanced Search button:
   (targcompdate >= { ts '2014-02-12 00:00:00.000' } and

   '%1205%')
   ------------------------------------
   Because Target Start on the PM is set to midnight (without any
   milliseconds), the PM WOGEN process shouldn't include
   millseconds when it sets
   the target start/target finish otherwise searches like this will
   fail.

   2014-02-12 00:00:00.817
- `E4.S24`: This has been the same since 71X and still occurs on 7505.
- `E4.S25`: PROBLEM CONCLUSION
 *  The millisecond portion of targstartdate and targcompdate on
   work orders generated from PMs will be zero.

- `E2.S1`: TPAEMSSQL; TPAEDB2; getdate; TPAEDATABASE; TPAEORACLE TECHNOTE (FAQ)
- `E2.S2`: QUESTION
 What would be the equivalent of MSSQL getdate() function for Maximo running on DB2 or Oracle?
- `E2.S3`: ANSWER
The getdate() MSSQL function can be replaced by value from DB2 CURRENT DATE special register. On Oracle, sysdate is used to retrieve the current date.
- `E2.S4`: EXAMPLE : MSSQL and transdate <= ( getdate() - 35)
- `E2.S5`: DB2 and transdate <= ( CURRENT DATE - 35 DAYS)
- `E2.S6`: Oracle and transdate <= ( sysdate - 35)
- `E2.S7`: RELATED INFORMATION
 URL [http://publib.boulder.ibm.com/infocenter/db2luw/v9r7/index.jsp]

- `E4.S1`: PRODUCT LIFECYCLE
- `E4.S2`: ABSTRACT
 IBM is pleased to announce a new support option available to you when your software reaches End of Service (EOS). IBM will offer Continuing Support for select Master Data Management (MDM) products and releases. This offering will provide you with continued access to the same knowledgeable global Support team you are working with today.
- `E4.S3`: CONTENT
IBM is pleased to announce a new support option available to you when your software reaches End of Service (EOS). IBM will offer Continuing Support for MDM Version 10.0 and MDM 10.1, for all editions (part ID 5725-E59). This offering will provide you with continued access to the same knowledgeable global Support team you are working with today.
World-Class Software Support
- `E4.S4`: Under your IBM Passport Advantage agreement's (International Passport Advantage Agreement or International Passport Advantage Express Agreement) Software Subscription and Support (S&S) terms, you receive comprehensive cross-platform technical assistance from a team of highly skilled Support experts. Additionally, you get flexible upgrade protection, access to the latest software versions and releases, remote technical support, 24x7 support for business-critical outages, online self-help resources, and unlimited electronic and voice access (where available) to world-class global IBM Software Support Centers.
- `E4.S5`: Continuing Support Option
- `E4.S6`: Continuing Support extends support for your software beyond its EOS date. When your software versions reach their End of Service date and support is no longer available through standard Software S&S, you now have the option for Continuing Support and no longer need to tackle support issues on your own.
- `E4.S7`: Continuing Support Program Benefits
- `E4.S8`: This exciting offering allows you to enjoy many of the S&S benefits that you have told us matter most to you, including:
- `E4.S9`: · 7 days, 24-hour support for mission critical emergencies (Severity 1) 
· Provided by voice in most countries. 
· Provided in English, with the local language accommodated when possible. 
· Remote problem analysis and assistance during normal country business hours in your time zone. 
· Support for routine, short duration installation and usage questions. 
· Response time objective of two hours during prime shift for voice and electronic problem submissions.
· Response objective for critical/emergency problems during off-shift hours is two hours. 
· Unlimited number of technical support incidents. 
· Access to documentation, technotes and other online product material. 
· Access to existing available fixes created before the product's EOS date to correct known defects.
- `E4.S10`: The Continuing Support offering does not include:
- `E4.S11`: · Voice and electronic access support for code-related problems. 
· Development analysis of new defects. 
· Development of or packaging fixes that are not already available. 
· Support for Supporting Programs and third party components. 
· Infrastructure that are not included in the software version’s Hardware and Software Requirement page.
- `E4.S12`: Program Participation
- `E4.S13`: To receive Continuing Support, you only need to maintain active S&S for licenses deployed for the software. If you are not current on S&S, please contact us (askCS@us.ibm.com) to discuss reinstatement options.
- `E4.S14`: Complete Coverage for Mission Critical Installations
- `E4.S15`: In addition to Continuing Support, IBM still provides the option for Service Extension (SE). Customers will have the choice between Continuing Support and Service Extension.
- `E4.S16`: Continuing Support, you only need to maintain active S&S for licenses deployed for the software. If you are not current on S&S, please contact us (askCS@us.ibm.com) to discuss reinstatement options.
- `E4.S17`: Complete Coverage for Mission Critical Installations
- `E4.S18`: In addition to Continuing Support, IBM still provides the option for Service Extension (SE). Customers will have the choice between Continuing Support and Service Extension. For mission critical installations, it is highly recommended that you continue to pro-actively purchase a Service Extension to receive full defect and development support assistance. By adding this offering, you will be maintaining the same full defect support coverage you received before the End of Service date, further protecting your installation. If you require development or defect support assistance after the End of Service for any version, including during the life of Continuing Support or with an active Upgrade Bridge contract, you will be required to purchase a Service Extension at that time at IBM's specified charge in order to receive such support. Contact your IBM sales representative for more information, or to purchase these options.
- `E4.S19`: FAQs
- `E4.S20`: 1. Why should I take advantage of Continuing Support?
Continuing Support provides flexibility for you to remain up and running on your software version with non-defect Support until you are able to upgrade to the latest version. Continuing Support provides uninterrupted access to many of the benefits of S&S and is more affordable than other options, such as a Service Extension.
- `E4.S21`: 2. What is the cost of Continuing Support and how do I buy it?
Continuing Support is available when you maintain active S&S. To avoid possible delays in receiving Support, you are encouraged to email askcs@us.ibm.com or your Sales contact.
- `E4.S22`: 3. I am on a software version which is out of support, and would like to benefit from this offering.
Continuing Support is now available to clients running Master Data Management V10.0 and V10.1, for all editions. To learn more about Continuing Support for your installations, please contact your local sales representative or email inquiries to askcs@us.ibm.com
- `E4.S23`: 4. Are special builds included with Continuing Support?
Continuing Support assistance provides you with access to pre-existing and available fixes. Special builds will NOT be created as part of this offering. If a special build is required, you will need first to purchase and sign a contract for a Service Extension.
- `E4.S24`: 5. Should I purchase a Service Extension (SE) instead of relying on Continuing Support assistance?
If your business requires the same comprehensive full-defect coverage it relied on before the EOS date, you will want to purchase a SE, if available. A SE is recommended for maximum coverage for your mission critical installations.
- `E4.S25`: 6. What if I have already purchased a Service Extension (SE) for my software licenses?
You should evaluate your true business need. If you require maximum Support coverage, you should maintain the SE for optimum coverage (this is recommended). If the Support offerings available through Continuing Support for non-defect support are sufficient, you may cancel your SE agreement. By cancelling your SE agreement, you will remove coverage for defect assistance and will be required to pay an increased fee if defect correction is required.
- `E4.S26`: for my software licenses?
You should evaluate your true business need. If you require maximum Support coverage, you should maintain the SE for optimum coverage (this is recommended). If the Support offerings available through Continuing Support for non-defect support are sufficient, you may cancel your SE agreement. By cancelling your SE agreement, you will remove coverage for defect assistance and will be required to pay an increased fee if defect correction is required.
- `E4.S27`: For more information
To get more information about the Continuing Support offering, email us at askcs@us.ibm.com [askcs@us.ibm.com]

What is the latest version of the Log File Agent? What is the latest version of the Log File Agent?

The latest version of the Log File Agent is 6.2.3.2 Interim Fix 07, which is also known as 6.2.3.2-TIV-ITM_LFA-IF0007.

Reference evidence:
- `1b`: Tivoli Log File Agent, Version 6.2.3.2 Interim Fix 07 6.2.3.2-TIV-ITM_LFA-IF0007 [http://www-01.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg24038012] SUBSCRIBE

=== CANDIDATE A ===

Model-visible evidence:
- `E1.S1`: A FIX IS AVAILABLE
Tivoli Log File Agent, Version 6.2.3.2 Interim Fix 07 6.2.3.2-TIV-ITM_LFA-IF0007 [http://www-01.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg24038012]
- `E1.S2`: SUBSCRIBE
You can track all active APARs for this component.
- `E1.S3`: APAR STATUS
 * CLOSED AS PROGRAM ERROR.
- `E1.S4`: ERROR DESCRIPTION
 *  The Log File Agent is monitoring a file on a mounted file
   system.  Once a day the file system is unmounted and copied.
   The file system is remounted and the log is created when a new
   entry is created.  There is a timing condition that happens
   where a return code 26, file busy is returned while the file
   system is unmounted and remounted.  The log file is no longer
   monitored after the error code is returned.  The log shows this:
   .
- `E1.S5`: (50F6C071.0001-14:kraaevst.cpp,678,"listSitStat") *STAT-INFO:
   *********************************************
   (50F811F1.0000-14:kraaevst.cpp,664,"listSitStat") *STAT-INFO:
   *************** Situation Statistics Fri Jan 18 00:00:01 2013
   (50F811F1.0001-14:kraaevst.cpp,678,"listSitStat") *STAT-INFO:
   *********************************************
   (50F8956B.0000-E:kumpwfrm.c,270,"KUMP_WaitFileReadyForMonitor")
   Opening file /s01az03p06/p/BAXX/log/latest/BAXX.log
   FILEEXISTWAIT=Y size 0
   (50F8956B.0001-E:kumpwfrm.c,321,"KUMP_WaitFileReadyForMonitor")
   ***  Unable to open file /s01az03p06/p/BAXX/log/latest/BAXX.log,
   Errno: 26, ErrorText: Text file busy, NO retry. Exiting
   (50F8956B.0002-E:kumpfdp5.c,342,"CheckFileExistAndReady") ***
   File /s01az03p06/p/BAXX/log/latest/BAXX.log -- initial
   monitoring setup
   failed(50F8956B.0003-E:kumpfile.c,1113,"KUMP_FileServer") >>>>>
   DP file server process ended for file
   /s01az03p06/p/BAXX/log/latest/BAXX.log last position 175
   current/last EOF 175/175. ThreadID: E
   .
   RECREATE INSTRUCTIONS:
   Attempted to recreate with a mounted file system.  This is a
   timing issue, and I was not able to recreate the problem.
   .
   Approver Initials: JW
- `E1.S6`: LOCAL FIX
 *  The workaround for this problem is to create the monitored
   file after remounting the file system.
- `E1.S7`: PROBLEM SUMMARY
 *  When monitoring a file on a mounted file system, there is a
   timing condition when opening the file where a return code 26,
   file busy is returned while the file system is un-mounted and
   remounted.  The log file is no longer monitored after the error
   code is returned.
- `E1.S8`: This problem was found on Log File Agent 6.2.3 FP1, but existed
   in prior releases.
- `E1.S9`: PROBLEM CONCLUSION
 *  If a return code 26 (file busy) is returned when opening the
   file, the agent now wait and tries to open the file again.
- `E1.S10`: The fix for this APAR is included in the following maintenance
   vehicle:
- `E1.S11`: | interim fix | 6.2.3.2-TIV-ITM_LFA-IF0003
- `E1.S12`: available at
   http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg24034607 [http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg24034607]
- `E1.S13`: It is also included in Log File Agent, v6.3 (CIGM5ML).

- `E1.S2`: SUBSCRIBE
You can track all active APARs for this component.
- `E1.S3`: APAR STATUS
 * CLOSED AS PROGRAM ERROR.
- `E1.S4`: ERROR DESCRIPTION
 *  The Log File Agent is monitoring a file on a mounted file
   system.  Once a day the file system is unmounted and copied.
   The file system is remounted and the log is created when a new
   entry is created.  There is a timing condition that happens
   where a return code 26, file busy is returned while the file
   system is unmounted and remounted.  The log file is no longer
   monitored after the error code is returned.  The log shows this:
   .
- `E1.S5`: (50F6C071.0001-14:kraaevst.cpp,678,"listSitStat") *STAT-INFO:
   *********************************************
   (50F811F1.0000-14:kraaevst.cpp,664,"listSitStat") *STAT-INFO:
   *************** Situation Statistics Fri Jan 18 00:00:01 2013
   (50F811F1.0001-14:kraaevst.cpp,678,"listSitStat") *STAT-INFO:
   *********************************************
   (50F8956B.0000-E:kumpwfrm.c,270,"KUMP_WaitFileReadyForMonitor")
   Opening file /s01az03p06/p/BAXX/log/latest/BAXX.log
   FILEEXISTWAIT=Y size 0
   (50F8956B.0001-E:kumpwfrm.c,321,"KUMP_WaitFileReadyForMonitor")
   ***  Unable to open file /s01az03p06/p/BAXX/log/latest/BAXX.log,
   Errno: 26, ErrorText: Text file busy, NO retry. Exiting
   (50F8956B.0002-E:kumpfdp5.c,342,"CheckFileExistAndReady") ***
   File /s01az03p06/p/BAXX/log/latest/BAXX.log -- initial
   monitoring setup
   failed(50F8956B.0003-E:kumpfile.c,1113,"KUMP_FileServer") >>>>>
   DP file server process ended for file
   /s01az03p06/p/BAXX/log/latest/BAXX.log last position 175
   current/last EOF 175/175. ThreadID: E
   .
   RECREATE INSTRUCTIONS:
   Attempted to recreate with a mounted file system.  This is a
   timing issue, and I was not able to recreate the problem.
   .
   Approver Initials: JW
- `E1.S6`: LOCAL FIX
 *  The workaround for this problem is to create the monitored
   file after remounting the file system.
- `E1.S7`: PROBLEM SUMMARY
 *  When monitoring a file on a mounted file system, there is a
   timing condition when opening the file where a return code 26,
   file busy is returned while the file system is un-mounted and
   remounted.  The log file is no longer monitored after the error
   code is returned.
- `E1.S8`: This problem was found on Log File Agent 6.2.3 FP1, but existed
   in prior releases.
- `E1.S9`: PROBLEM CONCLUSION
 *  If a return code 26 (file busy) is returned when opening the
   file, the agent now wait and tries to open the file again.
- `E1.S10`: The fix for this APAR is included in the following maintenance
   vehicle:
- `E1.S11`: | interim fix | 6.2.3.2-TIV-ITM_LFA-IF0003
- `E1.S12`: available at
   http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg24034607 [http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg24034607]
- `E1.S13`: It is also included in Log File Agent, v6.3 (CIGM5ML).

## techqa_DEV_Q296#row-0040

Question:
Does the BPM internal Document Store work with IBM DB2 pureScale? I use IBM DB2 pureScale with my BPM installation. During startup of the server and initialization of the internal document store I see hanging threads in the systemOut.log and the process will not finish. How can this be solved? 

Reference / gold answer:
Yes, the BPM internal Document Store can work with IBM DB2 pureScale. If you are experiencing hanging threads during startup of the server and initialization of the internal document store, it may be due to issues with the pureScale setup and configuration. 

One potential solution is to ensure that the DB2 JCC properties for DB2 pureScale affinity are correctly configured on Tomcat. This involves setting pureScale member host names in the operating system's hosts file, adding JNDI resource information to the web application environment file, adding JNDI data source information to the Tomcat configuration file, and implementing custom code to retrieve supported user attributes from the underlying security repository.

By correctly configuring the DB2 JCC properties for DB2 pureScale affinity on Tomcat, you may be able to resolve the hanging threads issue during BPM server startup and internal document store initialization.

Reference evidence:
- `3c`:  How can I configure the DB2 JCC properties for DB2 pureScale affinity on Tomcat ? ANSWER
- `3d`: For Java applications including stand alone or web applications in the Web Application Server (WAS), the necessary DB2 JDBC properties for DB2 pureScale affinity configuration are same.
- `3e`: For the detail of the JDBC properties, refer to the link in this page below.
- `3f`: Following steps are an example configuration of the client affinity on Tomcat. 1.
- `3g`: Set pureScale member host names to the /etc/hosts of the operating system where Tomcat will be running.
- `3h`: As pureScale java client refers the serverlist which is received from pureScale server,
- `3i`: it's necessary to set the hosts and the pureScale member IP to the /etc/hosts file.
- `3j`: $ cat /etc/hosts ..... ### example
- `3k`: ### pureScale client
- `3l`: 192.168.153.65 db2ps1.au.ibm.com db2ps1
- `3m`: ### pureScale server
- `3n`: 192.168.153.64 db2ps2.au.ibm.com db2ps2 # pureScale member 0
- `3o`: 192.168.153.68 db2ps3.au.ibm.com db2ps3 # pureScale member 1 2.
- `3p`: Add JNDI resource information to the web application environment file <TOMCAT_HOME>/conf/web.xml. ........
- `3q`: <!-- add from this line--> <resource-ref> <res-ref-name>jdbc/sample</res-ref-name> <res-type>javax.sql.DataSource</res-type> <res-auth>Container</res-auth> </resource-ref>
- `3r`: <!-- to this line --> </web-app> 3.
- `3s`: Add JNDI data source information to tomcat configuration file <TOMCAT_HOME>/conf/context.xml
- `3t`: tomcat@db2ps1:~/tomcat7054/conf> cat context.xml
- `3u`: <?xml version='1.0' encoding='utf-8'?> <Context> <WatchedResource>WEB-INF/web.xml</WatchedResource>
- `3v`: <!-- added following from this lines --> <Resource auth="Container" driverClassName="com.ibm.db2.jcc.DB2Driver" name="jdbc/sample" password="psinst2" username="psinst2" type="javax.sql.DataSource" url="jdbc:db2://db2ps3.au.ibm.com:61118/sample" enableClientAffinitiesList="1" retryIntervalForClientReroute="2" affinityFailbackInterval="300" user="psinst2" enableSeamlessFailover="true" clientRerouteAlternateServerName="db2ps3.au.ibm.com,db2ps2.au.ibm.com" databaseName="sample" maxRetriesForClientReroute="3" clientRerouteAlternatePortNumber="61118,61118" driverType="4" currentSchema="psinst2" removeAbandoned="true" removeAbandonedTimeout="60" logAbandoned="true" />
- `3w`: <!-- to this lines --> </Context> 4.

Model-visible evidence:
- `E1.S1`: TECHNOTE (TROUBLESHOOTING)
- `E1.S2`: PROBLEM(ABSTRACT)
 Excessive lock duration during FileNet CM object store addon creation may result in SQL lock timeouts that will cause addon installation to fail.
- `E1.S3`: SYMPTOM
DB transactions are rolled back due to SQL timeout.
- `E1.S4`: CAUSE
When multiple DB2 pureScale members are active during FileNet CM addon creation, excessive SQL locking may occur, resulting in a potential lock timeout. This can result in transactions being rolled back, thereby resulting in the addon installation failing.
- `E1.S5`: DIAGNOSING THE PROBLEM
Examine both the P8 error log and the DB2 diagnostic logs for each active member for lock timeout error messages similar to the following:
- `E1.S6`: DB2 (db2diag.log):
FUNCTION: DB2 UDB, lock manager, sqlplWaitOnWP, probe:999
- `E1.S7`: MESSAGE : ZRC=0x80100044=-2146435004=SQLP_LTIMEOUT
"LockTimeOut - tran rollback Reason code 68
- `E1.S8`: P8 (p8_server_error.log): 
com.filenet.api.exception.EngineRuntimeException: FNRCE0019E: E_DEADLOCK_ERROR: The operation could not be completed due to a deadlock error. A retry might be appropriate.
Caused by: com.ibm.db2.jcc.am.SqlTransactionRollbackException: DB2 SQL Error: SQLCODE=-911, SQLSTATE=40001, SQLERRMC=68, DRIVER=4.15.82
- `E1.S9`: Note: The SQLERRMC=68 suggests that the root cause is a SQL lock timeout even though the P8 error message and SQLCODE suggest a deadlock occurred.
- `E1.S10`: RESOLVING THE PROBLEM
The lock timeouts can be avoided by only having a single DB2 pureScale member active during FileNet CM addon installation. Once addon installation has completed successfully, the other members can be brought back online.

- `E4.S1`: hang; slow; hung TECHNOTE (TROUBLESHOOTING)
- `E4.S2`: PROBLEM(ABSTRACT)
 Tivoli Workload Scheduler (TWS) performance degradation occurs during periods of high traffic in large TWS scheduling environments.
- `E4.S3`: SYMPTOM
The SystemOut.log file shows warning messages similar to:
- `E4.S4`: 0000001a ThreadMonitor W WSVR0605W: Thread "ORB.thread.pool : 123" (00000245) has been active for 773732 milliseconds and may be hung. There is/are 153 thread(s) in total in the server that may be hung.
- `E4.S5`: CAUSE
The limit to the number of threads allowed to process TWS operations is reached causing a performance bottleneck. This scenario will only occur in large TWS networks with a high activity level.
- `E4.S6`: RESOLVING THE PROBLEM
Perform the following steps:
- `E4.S7`: 1. Modify:
$TWA_HOME/eWAS/profiles/twaprofile/config/cells/DefaultNode/nodes/DefaultNode/servers/twaserver/resources-pme.xml
- `E4.S8`: 1a. Locate the Default Work Manager section:
- `E4.S9`: <factories xmi:type="workmanager:WorkManagerInfo" 
xmi:id="WorkManagerInfo_Default" name="DefaultWorkManager" 
jndiName="wm/default" description="WebSphere Default WorkManager" 
category="Default" minThreads="1" maxThreads="10" threadPriority="5"
numAlarmThreads="5" isGrowable="false">.
- `E4.S10`: 1b. Modify isGrowable to "true"
- `E4.S11`: 2. Restart the embedded WebSphere Application Server (eWAS):
- `E4.S12`: (In conman, run stopappserver;wait and startappserver.)
- `E4.S13`: This will allow eWAS to spawn more threads to process TWS operations.
- `E4.S14`: PRODUCT ALIAS/SYNONYM
 Maestro
TWS
TWA
- `E5.S1`: A FIX IS AVAILABLE
Version 8.5 Refresh Pack 7 for the IBM Business Process Manager products [http://www-01.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg24041575]
- `E5.S2`: SUBSCRIBE
You can track all active APARs for this component.
- `E5.S3`: APAR STATUS
 * CLOSED AS PROGRAM ERROR.
