- `E4.S2`: PROBLEM
Stale connections can occur after Portal server has been idle for a period of time and attempts to access the database.
- `E4.S3`: [1/19/12 22:16:42:351 EST] 00000036 SchedulerDaem E SCHD0104E: The
Scheduler poll daemon WPSTaskScheduler (wps/Scheduler) failed to load
tasks from the database due to an exception: com.ibm.websphere.
scheduler.SchedulerNotAvailableException: com.ibm.websphere.ce.cm.
StaleConnectionException: IO Error: A remote host did not respond
within the timeout period.
- `E4.S4`: SYMPTOM
After a period of inactivity, the Portal server becomes unresponsive.
- `E4.S5`: CAUSE
The Portal connection to the database is closed externally by a firewall or by the remote database due to inactivity. Because Portal is still holding onto this connection, we still think the connection is available, and so receive the stale connection exception.
- `E4.S6`: DIAGNOSING THE PROBLEM
Reviewing the Portal's systemOut.log we see the stale connection exception when attempting to access the database.
- `E4.S7`: RESOLVING THE PROBLEM
The solution is to reduce the Minimum Connections to 0 on the data source.
- `E4.S8`: This will cause WAS to remove all connections after a period of inactivity.
- `E4.S9`: In the WAS admin console, go to Resources -> JDBC -> Data sources
- `E4.S10`: For each of the 6 db domains, select the Connection pools link and
edit the Minimum connection folder.
- `E4.S11`: Restart the servers after the changes are made.
- `E5.S1`: FIXES ARE AVAILABLE
Version 8.5 Refresh Pack 6 for the IBM Business Process Manager products [http://www-01.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg24039185]
Version 8.5.0 Fix Pack 2 for the IBM Business Process Manager products [http://www-01.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg24040683]
- `E5.S2`: SUBSCRIBE
You can track all active APARs for this component.
- `E5.S3`: APAR STATUS
 * CLOSED AS PROGRAM ERROR.
- `E5.S4`: ERROR DESCRIPTION
 *  When you use IBM Business Process Manager (BPM), you might
   receive the following error messages in the log files:
- `E5.S5`: java.net.SocketException: Too many open files
- `E5.S6`: java.io.IOException: Signals that an I/O exception of some sort
   has occurred.  Reason:  Too many open files
- `E5.S7`: Java? virtual machine (JVM) is trying to get a handle on the
   ?IBM/BPM/profiles/<profileName>/searchIndex/artifact/<clusterNam
   e>\bpm.lock file.
- `E5.S8`: Depending on what IBM BPM was trying to do at the time, various
   other error messages might occur that are related to too many
   files being open in the JVM.
- `E5.S9`: PRODUCTS AFFECTED:
   IBM Business Process Manager (BPM) Advanced
   IBM BPM Standard
   IBM BPM Express
- `E5.S10`: LOCAL FIX
- `E5.S11`: PROBLEM SUMMARY
 *  File descriptor leaks on the bpm.lock file causes an error about
    there being too many files open.
- `E5.S12`: PROBLEM CONCLUSION
 *  A fix is available for IBM BPM V8.5.0.1 and V8.5.5.0 that
   ensures only one cluster member has write access to the index
   directory at a time.
- `E5.S13`: On Fix Central (http://www.ibm.com/support/fixcentral), search
   for JR51223:
- `E5.S14`: 1. Select IBM Business Process Manager with your edition from
   the product selector, the installed version to the fix pack
   level, and your platform, and then click Continue.
   2. Select APAR or SPR, enter JR51223, and click Continue.
- `E5.S15`: When you download fix packages, ensure that you also download
   the readme file for each fix. Review each readme file for
   additional installation instructions and information about the
   fix.

## techqa_DEV_Q092#row-0027

Question:
What versions of WSAS using Oracle 12c are supported? What versions of WSAS using Oracle 12c are supported?

Reference / gold answer:
The versions of WebSphere Application Server (WSAS) using Oracle 12c that are supported are as follows:

- For IBM Emptoris Contract Management 9.5 through 10.0.2.5, WSAS version 8.0.0.x with Interim Fix PI27100 is supported.
- For IBM Emptoris Program Management 10.0.0 through 10.0.2.5, WSAS version 8.5.0.x with Interim Fix PI27099 is supported.
- For IBM Emptoris Sourcing 10.0.0 through 10.0.2.5, WSAS version 8.5.0.x with Interim Fix PI27099 is supported.
- For IBM Emptoris Spend Analysis 10.0.0 through 10.0.2.5, WSAS version 8.5.0.x with Interim Fix PI27099 is supported.
- For IBM Emptoris Supplier Lifecycle Management 9.5 through 10.0.2.5, WSAS version 8.5.0.x with Interim Fix PI27099 is supported.
- For IBM Emptoris Strategic Supply Management 10.0.0 through 10.0.2.5, WSAS version 8.5.5.x with Interim Fix PI27099 is supported.
- For IBM Emptoris Rivermine Telecom Expense Management 6.5.x through 7.0.1, WSAS version 8.5.5.x with Interim Fix PI27099 is supported.
- For IBM Emptoris Services Procurement 10.0.0, WSAS version 8.5.5.x with Interim Fix PI27099 is supported.

These versions of WSAS with the specified Interim Fixes are compatible with Oracle 12c when running IBM Emptoris applications.

- `E2.S3`: ANSWER
Yes, IBM Enterprise Integrator for Domino 9.0.1 supports Oracle 12c on platforms Windows 2008 / R2 / 2012, RHEL 6, SLES 11 and AIX 7.1 as native client and ODBC. You should install the Oracle 12c client as per Oracle documentation on the machine for using as native client. You can use Oracle 12c similarly as with earlier versions of Oracle.

- `E3.S4`: ERROR DESCRIPTION
 *  The Jazz Reporting Service (JRS) gives an error if Oracle 12c is
   used as the database, and fails to connect with the following
   error message:
- `E3.S5`: "Data source connection test failed: CRRGW5548E An
   com.ibm.team.integration.reporting.db.exception.DbAccessExceptio
   n error occurred when validating the database connection, caused
   by !CRRGW6011E Database version detected is "Oracle Database 12c
   Enterprise Edition Release 12.1.0.2.0 - 64bit Production With
   the Partitioning, OLAP, Advanced Analytics and Real Application
   Testing options" but Oracle 10.2.0.0 or 11.2.0.2 or later is
   required"
- `E3.S6`: The workaround is to ignore the version check by adding
   com.ibm.team.datawarehouse.db.override.versioncheck=true to the
   app.properties file to ignore the version check.
- `E3.S7`: Refer to the following defect work item for details:
- `E3.S8`: https://jazz.net/jazz/resource/itemName/com.ibm.team.workitem.Wo [https://jazz.net/jazz/resource/itemName/com.ibm.team.workitem.Wo]

- `E4.S1`: SECURITY BULLETIN
- `E4.S2`: SUMMARY
 The IBM Emptoris Strategic Supply Management Suite, IBM Emptoris Rivermine Telecom Expense Management and IBM Emptoris Services Procurement products are affected by multiple security vulnerabilities that exist in the IBM SDK Java Technology Edition that is shipped with IBM WebSphere Application Server. The issues are disclosed in the Oracle Oct 2014 Java SE Critical Patch Update.
- `E4.S3`: VULNERABILITY DETAILS
- `E4.S4`: CVEID: CVE-2014-3566 [http://cve.mitre.org/cgi-bin/cvename.cgi?name=CVE-2014-3566]
- `E4.S5`: DESCRIPTION: Product could allow a remote attacker to obtain sensitive information, caused by a design error when using the SSLv3 protocol. A remote user with the ability to conduct a man-in-the-middle attack could exploit this vulnerability via a POODLE (Padding Oracle On Downgraded Legacy Encryption) attack to decrypt SSL sessions and access the plaintext of encrypted connections.
- `E4.S6`: CVSS Base Score: 4.3
CVSS Temporal Score: See https://exchange.xforce.ibmcloud.com/vulnerabilities/97013 [https://exchange.xforce.ibmcloud.com/vulnerabilities/97013] for the current score

CVSS Vector: (AV:N/AC:M/Au:N/C:P/I:N/A:N)
- `E4.S7`: CVEID: CVE-2014-6457 [http://cve.mitre.org/cgi-bin/cvename.cgi?name=CVE-2014-6457]
- `E4.S8`: DESCRIPTION: An unspecified vulnerability in Oracle Java SE and JRockit related to the JSSE component has partial confidentiality impact, partial integrity impact, and no availability impact.
- `E4.S9`: CVSS Base Score: 4

- `E5.S1`: TECHNOTE (TROUBLESHOOTING)
- `E5.S2`: PROBLEM(ABSTRACT)
 Based on Oracle documentation, it is always recommended to apply post-upgrade step after applying database patch. If you are using Oracle 12c or newer, it is recommended to run datapatch. If you are using Oracle 10 and 11, then you should do the @catbundle.sql psu apply.
- `E5.S3`: SYMPTOM
VA and unsupported patch detected for Oracle 12.1.0.2.0
- `E5.S4`: Guardium VA and Oracle 12c datapatch
- `E5.S5`: CAUSE
Based on Oracle documentation, it is always recommended to apply post-upgrade step after applying database patch. If you are using Oracle 12c or newer, it is recommended to run datapatch. If you are using Oracle 10 and 11, then you should do the @catbundle.sql psu apply. For more information on these post-upgrade step, please refer to Oracle support portal for more instruction.
- `E5.S6`: If customer database does not show anything in the DBA_REGISTRY_SQLPATCH view, then it is likely that the DBA never applied the post database patch step.
- `E5.S7`: See these Oracle references and make sure datapatch is run to make sure the database is upgraded.
- `E5.S8`: https://blogs.oracle.com/UPGRADE/entry/dbua_and_datapatch_some_things [https://blogs.oracle.com/UPGRADE/entry/dbua_and_datapatch_some_things]
- `E5.S9`: DIAGNOSING THE PROBLEM
VA and unsupported patch detected for Oracle 12.1.0.2.0
- `E5.S10`: RESOLVING THE PROBLEM
The post-upgrade datapatch execution in Oracle 12.1.0.2 is not completed.
- `E5.S11`: The solution is to apply the SQL changes manually after the DBA has completed the database upgrade to Oracle Database 12c:
- `E5.S12`: cd $ORACLE_HOME/OPatch
- `E5.S13`: ./datapatch -verbose
- `E5.S14`: https://www.pythian.com/blog/oracle-database-12c-patching-dbms_qopatch-opatch_xml_inv-and-datapatch/ [https://www.pythian.com/blog/oracle-database-12c-patching-dbms_qopatch-opatch_xml_inv-and-datapatch/]
- `E5.S15`: With Oracle 11g the latest patch is applied within the database using:
- `E5.S16`: SQL> @catbundle.sql psu apply
- `E5.S17`: Summary
- `E5.S18`: Oracle 12c introduced a new utility called datapatch which replaces the need to run the 11g command shown above.
- `E5.S19`: As with Oracle 11g, you first install the patch into the Oracle Home with all services & databases down. But with Oracle Database 12c, after restarting the database, simply run datapatch from the OPatch directory:
- `E5.S20`: cd $ORACLE_HOME/OPatch
- `E5.S21`: ./datapatch -verbose
- `E5.S22`: Now, the customer is saying that they installed a fresh new Oracle 12c and then patched the server. Then they created the database and ran select * from dba_registry_sqlpatch and no record was found. That because they did not run the datapatch step. The customer then questioned whether they need to run datapatch or not since this database is created after the server patch. That is a good question.
- `E5.S23`: Let's look at the possible scenario.
- `E5.S24`: If you don't run datapatch, then dba_registry_sqlpatch will have 0 row. There is no way for Guardium's Vulnerability Assessment to know if you really did patch the database or not as there is no other way to find this information by doing a JDBC connection. That is why when the Guardium test ran, it showed "Unsupported CVE database patch detected" as Guardium found nothing or potentially something that Guardium does not recognize and would not be able to parse it. Guardium cannot simply fail the test as failing it may or may not be the desired result. One can argue that I don't need to run datapatch because this database is created after the server was patched. This assumption may or may not be correct depending on how the database is created.
- `E5.S25`: parse it. Guardium cannot simply fail the test as failing it may or may not be the desired result. One can argue that I don't need to run datapatch because this database is created after the server was patched. This assumption may or may not be correct depending on how the database is created.
- `E5.S26`: Therefore, Guardium recommends running the datapatch step regardless. Also this is an abnormal case where it would only happen during the first few months of your database creation. After that, you would need to patch your database on a quarterly basis to satisfy Oracle security, so you will have to run datapatch each time.
- `E5.S27`: In an Oracle database, when the server is patched and a new database is created, here is what happens in dba_registry_sqlpatch

- `E1.S1`: TECHNOTE (FAQ)
- `E1.S2`: QUESTION
Is it possible to use Oracle 12c with IBM Enterprise Integrator for Domino 9.0.1?
- `E1.S3`: ANSWER
Yes, IBM Enterprise Integrator for Domino 9.0.1 supports Oracle 12c on platforms Windows 2008 / R2 / 2012, RHEL 6, SLES 11 and AIX 7.1 as native client and ODBC. You should install the Oracle 12c client as per Oracle documentation on the machine for using as native client. You can use Oracle 12c similarly as with earlier versions of Oracle.
- `E2.S1`: Oracle; 12c TECHNOTE (FAQ)
- `E2.S2`: QUESTION
 What versions of Tivoli Workload Scheduler (TWS) are supported with Oracle 12c?
- `E2.S3`: ANSWER
Oracle 12c is supported with IBM Workload Scheduler (IWS) v9.1, v9.2, and v9.3.
- `E2.S4`: NOTE: You can check the compatibility of TWS with various components by using the Software Product Compatibility Reports (SPCR) website: 
http://www.ibm.com/software/reports/compatibility/clarity/index.html [http://www.ibm.com/software/reports/compatibility/clarity/index.html]

 Maestro
TWS
IWS

- `E3.S1`: A FIX IS AVAILABLE
Rational Insight Fix Pack 7 (1.1.1.7) for 1.1.1 [http://www-01.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg24039168]
- `E3.S2`: SUBSCRIBE
You can track all active APARs for this component.
- `E3.S3`: APAR STATUS
 * CLOSED AS PROGRAM ERROR.
- `E3.S4`: ERROR DESCRIPTION
 *  The Jazz Reporting Service (JRS) gives an error if Oracle 12c is
   used as the database, and fails to connect with the following
   error message:
- `E3.S5`: "Data source connection test failed: CRRGW5548E An
   com.ibm.team.integration.reporting.db.exception.DbAccessExceptio
   n error occurred when validating the database connection, caused
   by !CRRGW6011E Database version detected is "Oracle Database 12c
   Enterprise Edition Release 12.1.0.2.0 - 64bit Production With
   the Partitioning, OLAP, Advanced Analytics and Real Application
   Testing options" but Oracle 10.2.0.0 or 11.2.0.2 or later is
   required"
- `E3.S6`: The workaround is to ignore the version check by adding
   com.ibm.team.datawarehouse.db.override.versioncheck=true to the
   app.properties file to ignore the version check.
- `E3.S7`: Refer to the following defect work item for details:
- `E3.S8`: https://jazz.net/jazz/resource/itemName/com.ibm.team.workitem.Wo [https://jazz.net/jazz/resource/itemName/com.ibm.team.workitem.Wo]
   rkItem/339475
- `E3.S9`: LOCAL FIX
- `E3.S10`: PROBLEM SUMMARY
 *  ****************************************************************
   * USERS AFFECTED:                                              *
   * Users using version prior to 6.0                             *
   ****************************************************************
   * PROBLEM DESCRIPTION:                                         *
   * Version check fails for Oracle 12c data warehouse            *
   ****************************************************************
   * RECOMMENDATION:                                              *
   ****************************************************************
- `E3.S11`: PROBLEM CONCLUSION
 *  Solution:
   The Oracle driver code in JRS was only supporting versions 10g
   and 11g of the database. Support for a 12c database was added.
   In addition, the JRS driver now allows versions 11.2+ and 12.1+
   of the Oracle JDBC driver.

## techqa_DEV_Q173#row-0147

Question:
ORA-01795 Error accessing Decision Center Business Console 8.7 I am working with ODM 8.7.0.0 when accessing the Business Console I am getting the below error message :
ORA-01795: maximum number of expressions in a list is 1000
The diagnostics do not contain any warning nor error.
The logs contain below exception : 
 java.lang.RuntimeException: java.sql.SQLException: ORA-01795: maximum number of expressions in a list is 1000
...
 Caused by: java.sql.SQLException: ORA-01795: maximum number of expressions in a list is 1000

Reference / gold answer:
Based on the provided context, it seems that the issue with ORA-01795 error accessing the Decision Center Business Console 8.7 in ODM 8.7.0.0 is related to a query using a list with more than 1000 elements as part of its query. The error message "ORA-01795: maximum number of expressions in a list is 1000" indicates that there are more than 1000 expressions in a list, causing the query to fail.

To address this issue, a fix may be needed in the code that handles the query to ensure that it does not exceed the limit of 1000 expressions in a list. It is recommended to check if there is a fix available for ODM 8.7.0.0 that addresses this specific issue. Alternatively, you may need to follow the instructions provided in the APAR documentation for a temporary fix or workaround until a permanent solution is available.

   parameter limitation.
- `E3.S11`: LOCAL FIX
 *  If there are > 1000 entries in the TI_DELTA_CATENTRY table, run
   a full preprocess/buildindex rather than a delta.
- `E3.S12`: PROBLEM SUMMARY
 *  USERS AFFECTED:
    WebSphere Commerce v7 users who are using Oracle and run a
   delta indexing job.
- `E3.S13`: PROBLEM ABSTRACT:
    Delta indexing will fail when there are > 1000 records in the
   TI_DELTA_CATENTRY table using Oracle
- `E3.S14`: BUSINESS IMPACT:
    Delta indexing will fail, the search index will not be updated.
- `E3.S15`: RECOMMENDATION:
- `E3.S16`: PROBLEM CONCLUSION
 *  The runtime cache invalidate code has been updated to handle
   scenario when catalog entry IDs exceed the Oracle 1000 max
   parameter limitation.

- `E4.S2`: abstract text
Flowchart save fail with Error ORA-01795. In flowchart log you can see entries like below : UA_SYSTEM_TABLES: DELETE FROM campaign.UA_AnnotationInfo WHERE (FLOWCHARTID = XXXXXX) AND (ANCHORID in (XX,XXX...... [TABLE ACC] CODE 11528: Database Error Database error (5): [SERVERERROR] Error from Server: ORA-01795: maximum number of expressions in a list is 1000 DB vendor code: 1795 DB vendor message: unica [sdbsrc:275]
- `E4.S3`: link to actual document
http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21979567 [http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21979567]
- `E5.S1`: SQL integration; ORA-01000; statement cache; bind variable; SQL TECHNOTE (TROUBLESHOOTING)
- `E5.S2`: PROBLEM(ABSTRACT)
 You can use IBM Business Process Manager SQL integration service to interact with the database. In a high workload, you might find that the prepared statement cache hit ratio is very low for the data source that is used by the SQL integration service. After increasing the statement cache size in the data source, an Oracle ORA-01000 error happens.
- `E5.S3`: SYMPTOM
You might see the following exception in SystemOut.log:
- `E5.S4`: java.sql.SQLException: ORA-01000: maximum open cursors exceeded
at oracle.jdbc.driver.T4CTTIoer.processError(T4CTTIoer.java:439)
at oracle.jdbc.driver.T4CTTIoer.processError(T4CTTIoer.java:395)
at oracle.jdbc.driver.T4C8Oall.processError(T4C8Oall.java:802)
at oracle.jdbc.driver.T4CTTIfun.receive(T4CTTIfun.java:436)
at oracle.jdbc.driver.T4CTTIfun.doRPC(T4CTTIfun.java:186)
at oracle.jdbc.driver.T4C8Oall.doOALL(T4C8Oall.java:521)
at oracle.jdbc.driver.T4CPreparedStatement.doOall8(T4CPreparedStatement.java:205)
at oracle.jdbc.driver.T4CPreparedStatement.executeForRows(T4CPreparedStatement.java:1008)
at oracle.jdbc.driver.OracleStatement.doExecuteWithTimeout(OracleStatement.java:1307)
at oracle.jdbc.driver.OraclePreparedStatement.executeInternal(OraclePreparedStatement.java:3449)
at oracle.jdbc.driver.OraclePreparedStatement.execute(OraclePreparedStatement.java:3550)
at oracle.jdbc.driver.OraclePreparedStatementWrapper.execute(OraclePreparedStatementWrapper.java:1374)
at com.ibm.ws.rsadapter.jdbc.WSJdbcPreparedStatement.pmiExecute(WSJdbcPreparedStatement.java:958)
at com.ibm.ws.rsadapter.jdbc.WSJdbcPreparedStatement.execute(WSJdbcPreparedStatement.java:625)
at teamworks.sql.SQLClient.executePreparedStatement(SQLClient.java:443)
at teamworks.sql.SQLClient.execute(SQLClient.java:216)
at teamworks.SQLConnector$5.execute(SQLConnector.java:232)
at teamworks.SQLConnector$5.execute(SQLConnector.java:228)
at teamworks.sql.SQLExecutor.doExecute(SQLExecutor.java:134)
at teamworks.sql.SQLExecutor.execute(SQLExecutor.java:79)
at teamworks.SQLConnector.execute(SQLConnector.java:227)
- `E5.S5`: CAUSE
The Oracle ORA-01000 error occurs because the statement cache size property for the data source is set to a value higher than the maximum number of open cursors in the Oracle database. But, in this case, it is not good to simply increase the maximum number of open cursors in the Oracle database.
- `E5.S6`: The root cause is that bind variable is not used in your SQL integration service. The SQL string that is passed to the SQL integration service contains literal values. Because most of the SQL statements for one SQL integration service have different literal values, a matching statement cannot be found in statement cache (shared pool). The cache hit ratio is very low and the execution plan is generated for each SQL statement every time.
- `E5.S7`: RESOLVING THE PROBLEM
To resolve this issue, use a bind variable in your SQL integration service.
- `E5.S8`: For information on how to use the bind variable in the IBM Business Process Manager SQL integration service, see the following developerWorks article: Using the SQL integration service with WebSphere Lombardi Edition V7.2 and WebSphere Application Server V7 [http://www.ibm.com/developerworks/websphere/tutorials/1110_phi/].
- `E5.S9`: To learn more about the Oracle ORA-01000 error and its corresponding solution, see the "ORA-01000: maximum open cursors exceeded" connecting to an Oracle database from WebSphere Application Server [http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21218727] document.
- `E5.S10`: Cross reference information Segment Product Component Platform Version Edition Business Integration IBM Business Process Manager Standard Databases AIX, Linux, Linux zSeries, Solaris, Windows 8.5, 8.0.1, 8.0, 7.5.1, 7.5 Business Integration IBM Business Process Manager Express Databases Linux, Windows 8.5, 8.0.1, 8.0, 7.5.1, 7.5 
PRODUCT ALIAS/SYNONYM
 BPM

- `E2.S1`: TECHNOTE (TROUBLESHOOTING)
- `E2.S2`: PROBLEM(ABSTRACT)
 After installing Decision Center and Decision Server, I try to access the Decision Center and Rule Execution Server (RES) consoles, and get a 'Page not found' error
- `E2.S3`: RESOLVING THE PROBLEM
- `E2.S4`: 1. From the application server console, check if the application EAR files for the Decision Center and the RES Management are deployed and have been started.
- `E2.S5`: 2. From the application server administration console, check the HTTP port number. Make sure you use this port number to access the console. For example, by default, the HTTP port number for WebSphere Application Server is 9080, but it might be configured to 9081 for the profile on which the ODM application is installed.
- `E2.S6`: 3. Check that the HTTP port is not being used [http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21264632] by another process. If it is, stop the other process and try to access the console again.
- `E2.S7`: 4. Examine the server logs. If they contain the following exception:
- `E2.S8`: com.ibm.ws.webcontainer.webapp.WebApp logServletError SRVE0293E: 
[Servlet Error]-[/moduleVersion/versioninfo.jsp]: 
com.ibm.ws.jsp.translator.JspTranslationException: JSPG0227E: Exception 
caught while translating /moduleVersion/versioninfo.jsp: 
java.lang.reflect.InvocationTargetException at 
com.ibm.ws.jsp.translator.JspTranslator.processVisitors(JspTranslator.java:139) at 
com.ibm.ws.jsp.translator.utils.JspTranslatorUtil.translateJsp(JspTranslatorUtil.java:254) at 
com.ibm.ws.jsp.translator.utils.JspTranslatorUtil.translateJspAndCompile(JspTranslatorUtil.java:121) at com.ibm.ws.jsp.webcontainerext.AbstractJSPExtensionServletWrapper.translateJsp(AbstractJSPExtensionServletWrapper.java:548)
- `E2.S9`: Ensure that the <WAS_install>/temp and <WAS_profile>/temp directories have sufficient read and write privileges for the non-root user. If possible, grant the user full access to the entire application server installation directory. Note that on Windows, you can check if you have the required privileges by right-clicking on the folder, choosing Properties, and going to the Security tab.
- `E2.S10`: Also ensure there are no JSP files which were compiled by another user in the above-mentioned directories.
- `E2.S11`: This error could also be due to the APAR PI09545 [http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg1PI09545], in which case apply the appropriate fix.
- `E2.S12`: 5. Ensure there are no firewall settings which are preventing access to the Decision Center or Rule Execution Server consoles.
- `E2.S13`: 6. Ensure that the Class loader order property is set to Classes loaded with local class loader first (parent last), for the ILOG Rule Execution Server Console module of the Rule Execution Server EAR. See Step 17 of the documentation at 
Operational Decision Manager V8.5.1 > Configuring > Configuring Operational Decision Manager on WebSphere Application Server > Configuring Rule Execution Server on WebSphere Application Server [http://pic.dhe.ibm.com/infocenter/dmanager/v8r5m1/index.jsp?topic=%2Fcom.ibm.odm.distrib.config.was%2Fconfig_ds_res_was8%2Ftsk_was_deploy_mgmt_ear.html]
- `E2.S14`: 7. Ensure that the Class loader order property is set to Classes loaded with local class loader first (parent last), for the teamserver module of the Decision Center EAR. See Step 5 of the documentation at 
Operational Decision Manager V8.5.1 > Configuring > Configuring Operational Decision Manager on WebSphere Application Server > Configuring the Decision Center consoles on WebSphere Application Server > Configuring the Decision Center consoles on WebSphere Application Server for distributed platforms > Step 4: Deploying the Decision Center EAR file [http://pic.dhe.ibm.com/infocenter/dmanager/v8r5m1/index.jsp?topic=%2Fcom.ibm.odm.distrib.config.was%2Fconfig_dc_websphere%2Ftsk_zlinux_change_class_load_seq.html]
- `E2.S15`: 8. Examine the server logs (including FFDC logs if working with WebSphere Application Server) and address any additional errors such as authentication errors [http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21578192].
- `E2.S16`: 9. After making the above changes, restart the server and try to access the console for the Decision Center and/or the Rule Execution Server again.

- `E4.S1`: SQL integration; ORA-01000; statement cache; bind variable; SQL TECHNOTE (TROUBLESHOOTING)
- `E4.S2`: PROBLEM(ABSTRACT)
 You can use IBM Business Process Manager SQL integration service to interact with the database. In a high workload, you might find that the prepared statement cache hit ratio is very low for the data source that is used by the SQL integration service. After increasing the statement cache size in the data source, an Oracle ORA-01000 error happens.
- `E4.S3`: SYMPTOM
You might see the following exception in SystemOut.log:
- `E4.S4`: java.sql.SQLException: ORA-01000: maximum open cursors exceeded
at oracle.jdbc.driver.T4CTTIoer.processError(T4CTTIoer.java:439)
at oracle.jdbc.driver.T4CTTIoer.processError(T4CTTIoer.java:395)
at oracle.jdbc.driver.T4C8Oall.processError(T4C8Oall.java:802)
at oracle.jdbc.driver.T4CTTIfun.receive(T4CTTIfun.java:436)
at oracle.jdbc.driver.T4CTTIfun.doRPC(T4CTTIfun.java:186)
at oracle.jdbc.driver.T4C8Oall.doOALL(T4C8Oall.java:521)
at oracle.jdbc.driver.T4CPreparedStatement.doOall8(T4CPreparedStatement.java:205)
at oracle.jdbc.driver.T4CPreparedStatement.executeForRows(T4CPreparedStatement.java:1008)
at oracle.jdbc.driver.OracleStatement.doExecuteWithTimeout(OracleStatement.java:1307)
at oracle.jdbc.driver.OraclePreparedStatement.executeInternal(OraclePreparedStatement.java:3449)
at oracle.jdbc.driver.OraclePreparedStatement.execute(OraclePreparedStatement.java:3550)
at oracle.jdbc.driver.OraclePreparedStatementWrapper.execute(OraclePreparedStatementWrapper.java:1374)
at com.ibm.ws.rsadapter.jdbc.WSJdbcPreparedStatement.pmiExecute(WSJdbcPreparedStatement.java:958)
at com.ibm.ws.rsadapter.jdbc.WSJdbcPreparedStatement.execute(WSJdbcPreparedStatement.java:625)
at teamworks.sql.SQLClient.executePreparedStatement(SQLClient.java:443)
at teamworks.sql.SQLClient.execute(SQLClient.java:216)
at teamworks.SQLConnector$5.execute(SQLConnector.java:232)
at teamworks.SQLConnector$5.execute(SQLConnector.java:228)
at teamworks.sql.SQLExecutor.doExecute(SQLExecutor.java:134)
at teamworks.sql.SQLExecutor.execute(SQLExecutor.java:79)
at teamworks.SQLConnector.execute(SQLConnector.java:227)
- `E4.S5`: CAUSE
The Oracle ORA-01000 error occurs because the statement cache size property for the data source is set to a value higher than the maximum number of open cursors in the Oracle database. But, in this case, it is not good to simply increase the maximum number of open cursors in the Oracle database.
- `E4.S6`: The root cause is that bind variable is not used in your SQL integration service. The SQL string that is passed to the SQL integration service contains literal values. Because most of the SQL statements for one SQL integration service have different literal values, a matching statement cannot be found in statement cache (shared pool). The cache hit ratio is very low and the execution plan is generated for each SQL statement every time.
- `E4.S7`: RESOLVING THE PROBLEM
To resolve this issue, use a bind variable in your SQL integration service.
- `E4.S8`: For information on how to use the bind variable in the IBM Business Process Manager SQL integration service, see the following developerWorks article: Using the SQL integration service with WebSphere Lombardi Edition V7.2 and WebSphere Application Server V7 [http://www.ibm.com/developerworks/websphere/tutorials/1110_phi/].
- `E4.S9`: To learn more about the Oracle ORA-01000 error and its corresponding solution, see the "ORA-01000: maximum open cursors exceeded" connecting to an Oracle database from WebSphere Application Server [http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21218727] document.
- `E4.S10`: Cross reference information Segment Product Component Platform Version Edition Business Integration IBM Business Process Manager Standard Databases AIX, Linux, Linux zSeries, Solaris, Windows 8.5, 8.0.1, 8.0, 7.5.1, 7.5 Business Integration IBM Business Process Manager Express Databases Linux, Windows 8.5, 8.0.1, 8.0, 7.5.1, 7.5

 BPM

- `E5.S10`: The runtime cache invalidate code does not have Oracle 1000 max
   parameter limitation.
- `E5.S11`: LOCAL FIX
 *  If there are > 1000 entries in the TI_DELTA_CATENTRY table, run
   a full preprocess/buildindex rather than a delta.
- `E5.S12`: PROBLEM SUMMARY
 *  USERS AFFECTED:
    WebSphere Commerce v7 users who are using Oracle and run a
   delta indexing job.
- `E5.S13`: PROBLEM ABSTRACT:
    Delta indexing will fail when there are > 1000 records in the
   TI_DELTA_CATENTRY table using Oracle
- `E5.S14`: BUSINESS IMPACT:
    Delta indexing will fail, the search index will not be updated.
- `E5.S15`: RECOMMENDATION:
- `E5.S16`: PROBLEM CONCLUSION
 *  The runtime cache invalidate code has been updated to handle
   scenario when catalog entry IDs exceed the Oracle 1000 max
   parameter limitation.

    The latest available maintenance information can be obtained

## techqa_DEV_Q146#row-0056

Question:
Gettting error CRIMC1020E: zip im.properties not found during BPM Fix Pack install During the BPM 7.5.1.2 Fix Pack install from the IBM Installation Manager, error window pop up with:

CRIMC1020E: zip im.properties 1.0.0.200911091101 not found ERROR: `zip im.properties 1.0.0.200911091101` not found in [path to sca.1.0.1.17.fp]. CRIMC1020E: zip config.registry 1.0.0.200911092301 not found
……

How can I resolve this error to complete the Fix Pack installation?

Reference / gold answer:
To resolve the error CRIMC1020E during the BPM 7.5.1.2 Fix Pack installation, you can follow these steps:

1. Check if the required files 'im.properties' and 'config.registry' are present in the specified path ([path to sca.1.0.1.17.fp]). If they are not found, you will need to download these files from the IBM Installation Manager repository.

2. After downloading the missing files, place them in the appropriate directory where the Fix Pack installation is looking for them.

3. Restart the Fix Pack installation process and ensure that the files 'im.properties' and 'config.registry' are correctly located and accessible to the installation process.

4. If the error persists, you may need to verify the integrity of the downloaded files and ensure that they are not corrupted.

By following these steps, you should be able to resolve the CRIMC1020E error and complete the BPM 7.5.1.2 Fix Pack installation successfully.

- `E2.S1`: RN1.5.2; RN1.5.3 TECHNOTE (TROUBLESHOOTING)
- `E2.S2`: PROBLEM(ABSTRACT)
 You use IBM Packaging Utility to delete a package or fix from a repository. Then, you install a package or a fix from the same repository by using IBM Installation Manager. You receive an error that files cannot be found.
- `E2.S3`: SYMPTOM
You receive one of the following errors:
- `E2.S4`: * From the graphical user interface:
- `E2.S5`: * Failed to find all installation files.
- `E2.S6`: Message ID: CRIMA1161E
- `E2.S7`: Installation Manager was unable to find all artifacts from input repository. A package has an issue that cannot be resolved by Installation Manager.
- `E2.S8`: Check the package repository for consistency. Otherwise, identify the package that has the issue by looking at the installation history. In Installation Manager, click File > Installation History. In console mode, enter S: View Installation History. Contact IBM customer support.
- `E2.S9`: 'jar file <file name>' not found in <repository>.
- `E2.S10`: 'zip file <file name>' not found in <repository>.
 * 
 * 
 * From the command line or console mode:
- `E2.S11`: * CRIMA1154E ERROR: Error installing.
- `E2.S12`: ERROR: 'jar file <file name>' not found in <repository>.
- `E2.S13`: ERROR: 'zip file <file name>' not found in <repository>.
- `E2.S14`: CAUSE
Packaging Utility deletes additional files when you delete a package or fix from a repository.
- `E2.S15`: RESOLVING THE PROBLEM
This issue has been fixed in Packaging Utility version 1.6.
- `E2.S16`: To work around this issue, use Packaging Utility to recopy the affected package or fix from the original source to the repository that is missing files.

 IBM WebSphere Application Server V7 Feature Pack for Service Component Architecture (SCA) Fix Pack 19 for distributed platforms, also known as SCA Feature Pack Fix Pack 1.0.1.19

SCA Feature Pack Fix Pack 1.0.1.19 is now available for your download through FTP and DD links by going to the Download Package section of this document. The ZIP files in the download package section below can be used for setting up local repository to install SCA Fix Pack 1.0.1.19 using IBM Installation Manager.
- `E3.S4`: WebSphere Application Server feature packs are a mechanism for providing major new application server function between product releases. By delivering new functions and support for industry standards between product releases, you can more quickly explore and implement new technologies within your business applications in today's rapidly changing business environments.
- `E3.S5`: IBM WebSphere Application Server V7 Feature Pack for SCA [http://www.ibm.com/software/webservers/appserv/was/featurepacks/sca/] delivers critical technology that enables adoption of key Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA) principles. As part of the larger SOA Foundation, which straddles all of IBM software brands, this offering delivers an integrated, open implementation of Service Component Architecture (SCA), a technology specified by IBM and other industry leaders through the Open SOA Collaboration (OSOA). For More details, visit the Information Center for SCA Feature Pack. [http://publib.boulder.ibm.com/infocenter/wasinfo/fep/index.jsp?topic=/com.ibm.websphere.soafep.multiplatform.doc/info/ae/ae/csca_overview.html]

If you are going to use IBM Installation Manager to import an existing WebSphere Application Server Version 7.0 installation that contains Version 1.0.0.x of the Feature Pack for SCA and then update it to Version 1.0.1.0, first use the Update Installer to remove any fixes that have been applied to the 1.0.0.x level using the Update Installer.

You can then install IBM Installation Manager on your local system and use it to import WebSphere Application Server Version 7.0 as well as to install the feature pack from the Web-based repositories.

Status: `ANSWER`

Visible answer:
Use IBM Packaging Utility to recopy the affected BPM fix or package from the original source into the repository that is missing the files. The issue is fixed in Packaging Utility version 1.6, so use that version or later. [E2.S15] [E2.S16]

For the SCA component, IBM provides ZIP files for creating a local repository and states that IBM Installation Manager must point to the SCA local import repository when using a local repository for future maintenance. [E3.S3] [E3.S7] [E3.S13]

 *  When you specify a filter containing square brackets like

 *  When you place your inbound web service  inside a toolkit and
   one parameter is defined as a complex type list, the inbound
   web service generated WSDL contains an array type definition
   in a non-existent namespace and the runtime-generated SOAP
   message does not accomplish the WSDL definition. As a result,
   the web service client reports an error when loading the wrong
   WSDL or parsing the SOAP response message.

 *  ****************************************************************
   * USERS AFFECTED:  IBM Business Process Manager (BPM)          *
   *                  Advanced                                    *
   *                  IBM BPM Express                             *
   *                  IBM BPM Standard                            *
   ****************************************************************
   * PROBLEM DESCRIPTION: When you place your inbound web         *
   *                      service  inside a toolkit and one       *
   *                      parameter is defined as a complex       *
   *                      type list, the inbound web service      *
   *                      generated WSDL contains an array type   *
   *                      definition in a non-existent            *
   *                      namespace and the runtime-generated     *
   *                      SOAP message does not accomplish the    *
   *                      WSDL definition. As a result, the web   *
   *                      service client reports an error when    *
   *                      loading the wrong WSDL or parsing the   *
   *                      SOAP response message.                  *
   ****************************************************************
   * RECOMMENDATION:                                              *
   ****************************************************************
   When you put the inbound web service inside a toolkit, the
   WSDL might use the namespace of the toolkit instead of the
   process application namespace. As a result, the array list
   items are created with the wrong namespace and wrong WSDL and
   a wrong SOAP message are generated.
- `E2.S9`: PROBLEM CONCLUSION
 *  A fix is available for IBM BPM V8.5.5.0 that ensures the
   correct namespace is used no matter where the web service is
   placed.

You can find the details regarding the "Security Bulletin: Multiple vulnerabilities in IBM Java SDK affect IBM OS Images for Red Hat Linux Systems and AIX (CVE-2015-0410 and CVE-2014-6593)" in the provided context. It includes information about the vulnerabilities, affected products, vulnerability details, remedies/fixes, references, related information, and more.

- `E1.S1`: SECURITY BULLETIN
- `E1.S2`: SUMMARY
 There are multiple vulnerabilities in IBM® SDK Java™ Technology Edition Version 6 and 7 that are used by IBM OS Images for Red Hat Linux Systems and AIX. These issues were disclosed as part of the IBM Java SDK updates in January 2015.
- `E1.S3`: VULNERABILITY DETAILS
CVEID: CVE-2015-0410 [http://cve.mitre.org/cgi-bin/cvename.cgi?name=CVE-2015-0410]
DESCRIPTION: An unspecified vulnerability related to the Security component could allow a remote attacker to cause a denial of service.
CVSS Base Score: 5
CVSS Temporal Score: See https://exchange.xforce.ibmcloud.com/vulnerabilities/100151 [https://exchange.xforce.ibmcloud.com/vulnerabilities/100151] for the current score
CVSS Environmental Score*: Undefined

DESCRIPTION: An unspecified vulnerability related to the JSSE component has partial confidentiality impact, partial integrity impact, and no availability impact.

- `E1.S5`: AFFECTED PRODUCTS AND VERSIONS
IBM OS Image for Red Hat Linux Systems 2.0.0.1 and earlier.
IBM OS Image for AIX 2.0.0.1 and earlier.
- `E1.S6`: REMEDIATION/FIXES
The deployed Red Hat Linux-based and AIX virtual machines on IBM PureApplication Systems types are affected. The solution is to apply the following IBM PureApplication System fix to the deployed virtual machines.

http://www-933.ibm.com/support/fixcentral/swg/selectFixes?parent=PureSystems&product=ibm/WebSphere/PureApplication+System&release=All&platform=All&function=fixId&fixids=+Java_Update_Linux_2++&includeSupersedes=0 [http://www-933.ibm.com/support/fixcentral/swg/selectFixes?parent=PureSystems&product=ibm/WebSphere/PureApplication+System&release=All&platform=All&function=fixId&fixids=+Java_Update_Linux_2++&includeSupersedes=0]

- `E2.S1`: SECURITY BULLETIN SUMMARY There are multiple vulnerabilities in IBM® SDK Java™ Technology Edition that is used by WebSphere Application Server underneath IBM Business Process Manager and WebSphere Lombardi Edition. These issues were disclosed as part of the IBM SDK Java™ Technology Edition updates in January 2015. This bulletin also addresses the “FREAK: Factoring Attack on RSA-EXPORT keys" TLS/SSL client and server vulnerability. VULNERABILITY DETAILS CVEID: CVE-2015-0138 [http://cve.mitre.org/cgi-bin/cvename.cgi?name=CVE-2015-0138] DESCRIPTION: A vulnerability in various IBM SSL/TLS implementations could allow a remote attacker to downgrade the security of certain SSL/TLS connections. An IBM SSL/TLS client implementation could accept the use of an RSA temporary key in a non-export RSA key exchange ciphersuite. This could allow a remote attacker using man-in-the-middle techniques to facilitate brute-force decryption of TLS/SSL traffic between vulnerable clients and servers. This vulnerability is also known as the FREAK attack. - `E3.S1`: SECURITY BULLETIN SUMMARY There are multiple vulnerabilities in IBM® Runtime Environment Java™ Technology Edition, Version 5.0 Service Refresh 16 Fix Pack 7 and Version 6 Service Refresh 16 Fix Pack 1 and earlier releases, that is used by IBM Tivoli Provisioning Manager. This also includes a fix for the Padding Oracle On Downgraded Legacy Encryption (POODLE) SSLv3 vulnerability (CVE-2014-3566). These were disclosed as part of the IBM Java SDK updates in October 2014 and January 2015. IBM WebSphere Application Server is shipped as a component of IBM Tivoli Provisioning Manager. Information about multiple vulnerabilities in IBM Java SDK affecting IBM WebSphere Application Server has been published in a security bulletin. VULNERABILITY DETAILS CVE-ID: CVE-2014-3566 [http://cve.mitre.org/cgi-bin/cvename.cgi?name=CVE-2014-3566] DESCRIPTION: Product could allow a remote attacker to obtain sensitive information, caused by a design error when using the SSLv3 protocol. A remote user with the ability to conduct a man-in-the-middle attack could exploit this vulnerability via a POODLE (Padding Oracle On Downgraded Legacy Encryption) attack to decrypt SSL sessions and access the plaintext of encrypted connections. - `E4.S1`: SECURITY BULLETIN SUMMARY There are multiple vulnerabiltities in the IBM® SDK Java™ Technology Edition that is shipped with IBM WebSphere Application Server. These issues were disclosed as part of the IBM Java SDK updates in July 2017. These may affect some configurations of IBM WebSphere Application Server Traditional, IBM WebSphere Application Server Liberty and IBM WebSphere Application Server Hypervisor Edition. - `E5.S1`: IBM WebSphere Application Server; WebSphere Lombardi SECURITY BULLETIN SUMMARY Multiple security vulnerabilities exist in the IBM SDK Java Technology Edition that is shipped with IBM WebSphere Application Server and included in the products that are listed in this document. VULNERABILITY DETAILS The affected products are shipped with a version of IBM WebSphere Application Server, which is shipped with an IBM SDK Java Technology Edition and is based on the Oracle Java Development Kit (JDK). Oracle has released the January 2014 critical patch updates (CPU), which contain security vulnerability fixes. The IBM SDK for Java Technology Edition has been updated to incorporate the critical patch updates. The following vulnerabilities are applicable to IBM WebSphere Application Server and for the affected product. CVEID: CVE-2014-0411 [http://cve.mitre.org/cgi-bin/cvename.cgi?name=CVE-2014-0411] Description: Timing differences based on validity of TLS messages CVSS Base Score: 4 CVSS Temporal Score: See https://exchange.xforce.ibmcloud.com/vulnerabilities/90357 [https://exchange.xforce.ibmcloud.com/vulnerabilities/90357] for the current score CVSS Environmental Score*: Undefined CVSS Vector: (AV:N/AC:H/Au:N/C:P/I:P/A:N) Vulnerability fixes for other advisories are included in the IBM SDK Java™ Technology Edition but IBM WebSphere Application Server and the products listed below are not vulnerable to them. You will need to evaluate your own code to determine if you are vulnerable. Refer to the Reference section for more information on the advisories not applicable to IBM WebSphere Application Server. AFFECTED PRODUCTS AND VERSIONS WebSphere Lombardi Edition V7.1.0.x, 7.2.0.x REMEDIATION/FIXES Install IBM WebSphere Application Server interim fixes as appropriate for your current IBM WebSphere Application Server version as described in Security Bulletin: Multiple vulnerabilities in current IBM SDK for Java for WebSphere Application Server January 2014 CPU [https://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21663938] WORKAROUNDS AND MITIGATIONS None GET NOTIFIED ABOUT FUTURE SECURITY BULLETINS Subscribe to My Notifications [ http://www-01.ibm.com/software/support/einfo.html] to be notified of important product support alerts like this. IMPORTANT NOTE IBM strongly suggests that all System z customers be subscribed to the System z Security Portal to receive the latest critical System z security and integrity service. If you are not subscribed, see the instructions on the System z Security web site [http://www.ibm.com/systems/z/solutions/security_subintegrity.html]. Security and integrity APARs and associated fixes will be posted to this portal. IBM suggests reviewing the CVSS scores and applying all security or integrity fixes as soon as possible to minimize any potential risk. Status: `ANSWER`

Visible answer:
The information is in IBM’s Security Bulletin for IBM OS Images for Red Hat Linux Systems and AIX. It covers IBM SDK Java Technology Edition versions 6 and 7 and issues disclosed in the January 2015 IBM Java SDK updates. [E1.S1] [E1.S2]

The bulletin describes CVE-2015-0410 as a Security-component vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to cause denial of service, with a CVSS base score of 5. [E1.S3]

It describes CVE-2014-6593 as a JSSE-component vulnerability with partial confidentiality and integrity impact and no availability impact, with a CVSS base score of 4. [E1.S4]

Affected products are IBM OS Image for Red Hat Linux Systems 2.0.0.1 and earlier and IBM OS Image for AIX 2.0.0.1 and earlier. [E1.S5]

For remediation details, consult the IBM PureApplication System fixes: Java Update for Linux and Java Update for AIX. The bulletin instructs users to import the fix into the Emergency Fix catalogue, apply it to deployed virtual machines, and restart the instances. [E1.S6] [E1.S7] [E1.S8] [E1.S9]

IBM lists the IBM Secure Engineering Web Portal and IBM Product Security Incident Response Blog as related information sources, and recommends subscribing to My Notifications for future security bulletins. [E1.S11] [E1.S13]

- `E3.S1`: CVE-2015-0138; CVE-2015-0410; CVE-2014-6593 SECURITY BULLETIN SUMMARY There are multiple vulnerabilities in IBM® SDK Java™ Technology Edition, Versions 6 and 7 that is used by Rational Developer for System z. These issues were disclosed as part of the IBM Java SDK updates in January 2015. This bulletin also addresses the “FREAK: Factoring Attack on RSA-EXPORT keys" TLS/SSL client and server vulnerability.. VULNERABILITY DETAILS Subscribe to My Notifications to be notified of important product support alerts like this. * Follow this link [https://www.ibm.com/systems/support/myview/subscription/css.wss/subscriptions?methodName=startSearchToSubscribe&uctug_rational_dcfsbblurb_2013-11-05_myn_adoption_promo] for more information (requires login with your IBM ID) CVEID: CVE-2015-0138 [http://cve.mitre.org/cgi-bin/cvename.cgi?name=CVE-2015-0138] DESCRIPTION: A vulnerability in various IBM SSL/TLS implementations could allow a remote attacker to downgrade the security of certain SSL/TLS connections. An IBM SSL/TLS client implementation could accept the use of an RSA temporary key in a non-export RSA key exchange ciphersuite. This could allow a remote attacker using man-in-the-middle techniques to facilitate brute-force decryption of TLS/SSL traffic between vulnerable clients and servers. This vulnerability is also known as the FREAK attack. CVSS Base Score: 4.3 CVSS Temporal Score: See http://exchange.xforce.ibmcloud.com/#/vulnerabilities/100691 [http://exchange.xforce.ibmcloud.com/#/vulnerabilities/100691] for the current score CVSS Environmental Score*: Undefined CVSS Vector: (AV:N/AC:M/Au:N/C:N/I:P/A:N) CVEID: CVE-2015-0410 [http://cve.mitre.org/cgi-bin/cvename.cgi?name=CVE-2015-0410] DESCRIPTION: An unspecified vulnerability related to the Security component could allow a remote attacker to cause a denial of service. CVSS Base Score: 5 CVSS Temporal Score: See https://exchange.xforce.ibmcloud.com/vulnerabilities/100151 [https://exchange.xforce.ibmcloud.com/vulnerabilities/100151] for the current score CVSS Environmental Score*: Undefined CVSS Vector: (AV:N/AC:L/Au:N/C:N/I:N/A:P) CVEID: CVE-2014-6593 [http://cve.mitre.org/cgi-bin/cvename.cgi?name=CVE-2014-6593] DESCRIPTION: An unspecified vulnerability related to the JSSE component has partial confidentiality impact, partial integrity impact, and no availability impact. CVSS Base Score: 4 CVSS Temporal Score: See https://exchange.xforce.ibmcloud.com/vulnerabilities/100153 [https://exchange.xforce.ibmcloud.com/vulnerabilities/100153] for the current score CVSS Environmental Score*: Undefined CVSS Vector: (AV:N/AC:H/Au:N/C:P/I:P/A:N) AFFECTED PRODUCTS AND VERSIONS Principal Product and Version(s) Affected Supporting Product and Version Rational Developer for System z, versions 9.1.x, 9.0.x, 8.5.x * IBM SDK, Java Technology Edition, Version 6 Service Refresh 16 FP3 and earlier * IBM SDK, Java Technology Edition, Version 7 Service Refresh 8 FP10 and earlier REMEDIATION/FIXES IBM has provided patches for all affected versions. Follow the installation instructions in the README files included with the patch. The fix can be obtained at the following locations: * Rational Developer for System z Interim Fix 3 for 8.5.x [http://www-01.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg24039791] * Rational Developer for System z Interim Fix 3 for 9.0.x [http://www-01.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg24039792] * Rational Developer for System z Interim Fix 3 for 9.1.x [http://www-01.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg24039793] GET NOTIFIED ABOUT FUTURE SECURITY BULLETINS Subscribe to My Notifications [ http://www-01.ibm.com/software/support/einfo.html] to be notified of important product support alerts like this. IMPORTANT NOTE IBM strongly suggests that all System z customers be subscribed to the System z Security Portal to receive the latest critical System z security and integrity service. If you are not subscribed, see the instructions on the System z Security web site [http://www.ibm.com/systems/z/solutions/security_subintegrity.html]. Security and integrity APARs and associated fixes will be posted to this portal. IBM suggests reviewing the CVSS scores and applying all security or integrity fixes as soon as possible to minimize any

Status: `ANSWER`

Visible answer:
The security bulletin is available through IBM Support documentation. Its related-information links include the IBM Secure Engineering Web Portal at http://www.ibm.com/security/secure-engineering/bulletins.html and the IBM Product Security Incident Response Blog at http://www.ibm.com/blogs/psirt. [E1.S13]

For the affected IBM OS Images, the bulletin covers IBM OS Image for Red Hat Linux Systems 2.0.0.1 and earlier and IBM OS Image for AIX 2.0.0.1 and earlier. [E1.S5]

The bulletin describes CVE-2015-0410 as a Security-component vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to cause denial of service, with a CVSS base score of 5. [E1.S3]

It describes CVE-2014-6593 as a JSSE-component vulnerability with partial confidentiality and integrity impact and no availability impact, with a CVSS base score of 4. [E1.S4]

For deployed Red Hat Linux-based and AIX virtual machines on IBM PureApplication Systems, IBM directs users to apply the IBM PureApplication System fix; the listed fixes are Java Update for Linux and Java Update for AIX. [E1.S6] [E1.S7] [E1.S8]

The bulletin states that users should import the fix into the Emergency Fix catalogue, apply it to deployed virtual machines, and restart the deployed instance afterward. The update upgrades IBM Java JDK 7.0 to SR8 FP10 interim fix and IBM Java JDK 6.0 to SR16 FP3 interim fix. [E1.S9]

## techqa_DEV_Q238#row-0136

Question:
recently installed Impact 7.1.0. fixpack 3, now when ever start the secondary impact server, the primary servers logging stops?  How can I fix this? when NCI1 is running by itself, all logging is functioning. When NCI2
is started, logging stops on NCI1 and the "reader" logs indicate that
the readers have stopped. 

Reference / gold answer:
Based on the provided context, the issue you are experiencing after installing Impact 7.1.0 fixpack 3 is likely related to the clustering configuration and how the impact servers are interacting with each other. 

One potential cause for the logging issues when starting the secondary impact server could be related to the failover mechanism not functioning correctly. It seems that the servers are not properly transitioning the primary server role when the secondary server is started.

To resolve this issue, you may need to verify and update the configuration related to failover and clustering in Impact. The recent installation of the fix pack might have introduced changes that are affecting the failover process. 

You might need to review the cluster configuration settings, check the failover settings, and ensure that the servers are able to correctly transition roles from primary to secondary and vice versa. Additionally, reviewing the log files for any errors or warnings related to failover and replication can provide more insights into what might be causing the issue.

It is recommended to reach out to IBM support or refer to the Impact documentation for specific steps on configuring failover and resolving clustering issues in Impact servers.

Reference evidence:
- `0b`:  Attempting to start the Secondary ImpactServer fails.
- `0c`: Secondary ImpactServer fails to start.
- `0e`: Secondary ImpactServer fails to start, configuration not fully copied from Primary ImpactServer to Secondary file system. CAUSE
- `0h`: DIAGNOSING THE PROBLEM
- `0j`: In this instance the last thing it is attempting to replicate is the PolicyList.
- `0k`: RESOLVING THE PROBLEM

=== CANDIDATE A ===

- `E2.S2`: APAR STATUS
 * CLOSED AS DOCUMENTATION ERROR.
- `E2.S3`: ERROR DESCRIPTION
 *  Unlike events read by event readers, events processed by a
   policy launched by a policy activator are not processed by the
   event processor.  The implication of that is that in a
   normally-functioning cluster, events processed via an activated
   policy will only ever be processed on the current primary
   server.
- `E2.S4`: The Impact documentation should state this in order to avoid
   confusion.
- `E2.S5`: LOCAL FIX
 *  N/A
- `E2.S6`: PROBLEM SUMMARY
 *  ****************************************************************
   * USERS AFFECTED:                                              *
   * All Impact Users                                             *
   ****************************************************************
   * PROBLEM DESCRIPTION:                                         *
   * Question re policy activator: Q: Why doesn't the policy      *
   * activator run on the secondary cluster                       *
   * member? Can I do anything about it?                          *
   ****************************************************************
   * RECOMMENDATION:                                              *
   * It's expected behaviour that policy activators run only on   *
   * the primary.                                                 *
   *                                                              *
   * The only service normally active on a secondary server in    *
   * the cluster is the event processor.  The event processor     *
   * does not handle                                              *
   * events from policies activated by a policy activator, only   *
   * events read from event reader queues.  Therefore an event    *
   * processed via a policy activator will only ever be processed *
   * on the Impact server where the policy activator service is   *
   * running.                                                     *
   *                                                              *
   * There is no way of configuring this to behave differently in *
   * Impact itself currently.  However, it is possible to         *
   * activate a policy to run on the secondary by using a cron    *
   * job to run nci_trigger at intervals.  But the risk with this *
   * approach is that it will have no failover                    *
   * capability.  Another idea is to put the policies inside an   *
   * event reader of their own and set that event reader to have  *
   * a very                                                       *
   * long polling interval - the same frequency as your policy    *
   * activator.                                                   *
   ****************************************************************
- `E2.S7`: PROBLEM CONCLUSION
 *  Documentation will be updated with next Service Release
- `E2.S8`: TEMPORARY FIX

- `E5.S2`: APAR STATUS
 * CLOSED AS DOCUMENTATION ERROR.
- `E5.S3`: ERROR DESCRIPTION
 *  Unlike events read by event readers, events processed by a
   policy launched by a policy activator are not processed by the
   event processor.  The implication of that is that in a
   normally-functioning cluster, events processed via an activated
   policy will only ever be processed on the current primary
   server.
- `E5.S4`: The Impact documentation should state this in order to avoid
   confusion.
- `E5.S5`: LOCAL FIX
 *  N/A
- `E5.S6`: PROBLEM SUMMARY
 *  ****************************************************************
   * USERS AFFECTED:                                              *
   * All Impact Users                                             *
   ****************************************************************
   * PROBLEM DESCRIPTION:                                         *
   * Question re policy activator: Q: Why doesn't the policy      *
   * activator run on the secondary cluster                       *
   * member? Can I do anything about it?                          *
   ****************************************************************
   * RECOMMENDATION:                                              *
   * It's expected behaviour that policy activators run only on   *
   * the primary.                                                 *
   *                                                              *
   * The only service normally active on a secondary server in    *
   * the cluster is the event processor.  The event processor     *
   * does not handle                                              *
   * events from policies activated by a policy activator, only   *
   * events read from event reader queues.  Therefore an event    *
   * processed via a policy activator will only ever be processed *
   * on the Impact server where the policy activator service is   *
   * running.                                                     *
   *                                                              *
   * There is no way of configuring this to behave differently in *
   * Impact itself currently.  However, it is possible to         *
   * activate a policy to run on the secondary by using a cron    *
   * job to run nci_trigger at intervals.  But the risk with this *
   * approach is that it will have no failover                    *
   * capability.  Another idea is to put the policies inside an   *
   * event reader of their own and set that event reader to have  *
   * a very                                                       *
   * long polling interval - the same frequency as your policy    *
   * activator.                                                   *
   ****************************************************************
- `E5.S7`: PROBLEM CONCLUSION
 *  Documentation will be updated with next Service Release
- `E5.S8`: TEMPORARY FIX

Status: `ANSWER`

Visible answer:
The supplied documentation also describes a separate expected cluster behavior: policy activators run only on the primary, while the event processor is normally active on the secondary. Events processed through a policy activator therefore run only on the server where that activator is running; Impact itself has no configuration to change this behavior. [E5.S3] [E5.S6]

## techqa_DEV_Q051#row-0039

Question:
We got a NullPointerException when bootstrapping the object store or accessing Site Preferences/Access Role on WorkplaceXT 

After logging into FileNet Workplace XT, a java.lang.NullPointerException error is logged when bootstrapping the object store or when accessing Site Preferences/Access Role.

Here's the error stack,

Error Stack Trace extracted from the J2EE Application Server error log:

java.lang.NullPointerException

at org.apache.jasper.runtime.JspWriterImpl.write(JspWriterImpl.java:421)

at com.filenet.wcm.apps.server.ui.info.prefs.PrefAccessRolesInfoPage.renderRoleMembers(PrefAccessRolesInfoPage.java:254)

at com.filenet.wcm.apps.server.ui.info.prefs.PrefAccessRolesInfoPage.renderRole(PrefAccessRolesInfoPage.java:220)

at com.filenet.wcm.apps.server.ui.info.prefs.PrefBootstrapInfoPage.renderAdminRole(PrefBootstrapInfoPage.java:131)

at com.filenet.wcm.apps.server.ui.info.prefs.PrefBootstrapInfoPage.render(PrefBootstrapInfoPage.java:303)

Reference / gold answer:
Based on the provided context, the NullPointerException occurring when bootstrapping the object store or accessing Site Preferences/Access Role on WorkplaceXT is likely caused by an invalid entry specified in the User Display Name Attribute or Group Display Name Attribute in the Directory Services Configuration in FileNet Enterprise Manager (FEM). To resolve the issue, you need to change the User Display Name Attribute or Group Display Name Attribute to a valid LDAP entry, such as cn, displayName or uid, in FEM and then restart the FileNet Content Engine and Workplace XT instances. This should prevent the NullPointerException error from occurring.

Reference evidence:
- `0a`: java.lang.NullPointerException; workplacext bootstrap; user display name TECHNOTE (TROUBLESHOOTING) PROBLEM(ABSTRACT)
- `0b`:  After logging into FileNet Workplace XT, a java.lang.NullPointerException error is logged when bootstrapping the object store or when accessing Site Preferences/Access Role. SYMPTOM
- `0c`: Error Stack Trace extracted from the J2EE Application Server error log: java.lang.NullPointerException
- `0i`: This behavior may occur if an invalid entry has been specified in the User Display Name Attribute or Group Display Name Attribute setting in the Directory Services Configuration in FileNet Enterprise Manager (FEM).
- `0j`: Workplace XT attempts to resolve the user names and groups defined within the Access Roles based on the Directory Service configuration defined in FEM.
- `0k`: If the user name query resolves to null or if there is an invalid entry a NullPointerException error may occur.
- `0m`:  In FEM, change the User Display Name Attribute or Group Display Name Attribute to a valid LDAP entry such as cn, displayName or uid and restart the FileNet Content Engine and Workplace XT instances.

=== CANDIDATE A ===

- `E3.S7`: CAUSE
This message may be displayed when the Application Engine (Workplace) is unable to access the configuration files directory.
- `E3.S8`: DIAGNOSING THE PROBLEM
Inspect the contents of the deployed web.xml for the Workplace application ( typically under the J2EE application server deployed directory ...\Workplace\WEB-INF\web.xml).
- `E3.S9`: The configurationDirectory parameter indicates the location of the AE configuration files directory, for example on Microsoft Windows, it may indicate :
- `E3.S10`: <context-param>
<param-name>configurationDirectory</param-name> 
<param-value>C:\\Program Files\\FileNet\\Config\\AE</param-value> 
</context-param>
- `E3.S11`: RESOLVING THE PROBLEM
The Operating System user starting the J2EE application server needs to be able to read / write to the location identified as the "configurationDirectory" in web.xml, otherwise a NullPointerException may be displayed. Adjust file system / network share permissions as to allow access to this directory.
- `E4.S1`: Code=null， RoleName; OMFC/Search/ExecuteXML//RETRIEVE_PROPERTY_NOT_DEFINED; Workplace configuration; Site Preference TECHNOTE (TROUBLESHOOTING)
- `E4.S2`: PROBLEM(ABSTRACT)

- `E4.S3`: SYMPTOM
Error:

- `E4.S5`: CAUSE
During Object Store creation, the Access Role not created
- `E4.S6`: DIAGNOSING THE PROBLEM
During Object Store creation, the Access Role not created
- `E4.S7`: RESOLVING THE PROBLEM
Solution:
- `E4.S8`: - When using Wizard to create an Object Store, need to select the full set of addon extensions. RoleName (Access Roles) will be created with the install of the Workplace Addon Extensions.
- `E4.S9`: - Or if no addon extensions are selected during the object store creation, you can add the set of addoon extentions to the object store after its creation.

 FileNet
- `E5.S1`: WorkplaceXT; AppInt TECHNOTE (TROUBLESHOOTING)
- `E5.S2`: PROBLEM(ABSTRACT)
 Getting a NullPointerException from WorkplaceXT/Application Integration
- `E5.S3`: SYMPTOM
Getting prompted to logon twice when adding a document through Application Integration for WorkplaceXT/Microsoft Outlook and getting a NullPointerException when logging on at second time.
- `E5.S4`: After the first logon, user was promoted to logon again. When logging on at the second time, the following error occurred:
- `E5.S5`: --------------------------
"IBM FileNet Workplace XT Add: Unable to Perform Add Operation"
- `E5.S6`: Operation: SelectedAddProfile
Error Name: E_SVRCMDXMLPARSERFAILED
HRESULT: 0x8004042b
Description: Unable to parse command XML:null
Details: java.lang.NullPointerException
-------------------------
- `E5.S7`: After the error message dialog box was dismissed, adding a document from Outlook did not prompt for logon again for the current Outlook session. After starting a new Outlook session, the symptom repeated again.
- `E5.S8`: CAUSE
Since the WorkplaceXT was not configured for Single Sign On (SSO), the first logon was expected for each Outlook session. The unexpected second logon was due to the Application Integration error (see above).
- `E5.S9`: This error was caused by the jar files in <install_path>/IBM/WebShpere/AppServer/lib/ext directory of the WebShpere Applicaton Server (WAS) hosting the WorkplaceXT.
- `E5.S10`: In reference to the following page at P8 Knowledge Center
- `E5.S11`: "Configuring WebSphere Application Server to support user tokens and WebDAV connections for Workplace XT"
- `E5.S12`: http://www-01.ibm.com/support/knowledgecenter/SSNW2F_5.2.1/com.ibm.p8.installingxt.doc/wxtip018.htm [http://www-01.ibm.com/support/knowledgecenter/SSNW2F_5.2.1/com.ibm.p8.installingxt.doc/wxtip018.htm]
- `E5.S13`: there should be only two jar files in the following directory in WAS hosting the WorkplaceXT:
<install_path>/IBM/WebShpere/AppServer/lib/ext
- `E5.S14`: RESOLVING THE PROBLEM
Steps to resolve the problem:
- `E5.S15`: 1. Stopped WAS hosting the WorkplaceXT
2. Removed any additional jar files from the <install_path>/IBM/WebShpere/AppServer/lib/ext directory so that the directory contained only two jar files:
- `E5.S16`: - authentication-websphere.jar
- log4j_1.2.13.jar
- `E5.S17`: 3. Deleted WorkplaceXT folder from the WAS wstemp folder, and clear the browser cache
4. Started WebSphere Application Server
- `E5.S18`: After implementing the above procedure, the problem was resolved. User started to get a logon prompt only once as expected.

- `E3.S11`: "Configuring WebSphere Application Server to support user tokens and WebDAV connections for Workplace XT"
- `E3.S12`: http://www-01.ibm.com/support/knowledgecenter/SSNW2F_5.2.1/com.ibm.p8.installingxt.doc/wxtip018.htm [http://www-01.ibm.com/support/knowledgecenter/SSNW2F_5.2.1/com.ibm.p8.installingxt.doc/wxtip018.htm]
- `E3.S13`: there should be only two jar files in the following directory in WAS hosting the WorkplaceXT:
<install_path>/IBM/WebShpere/AppServer/lib/ext
- `E3.S14`: RESOLVING THE PROBLEM
Steps to resolve the problem:
- `E3.S15`: 1. Stopped WAS hosting the WorkplaceXT
2. Removed any additional jar files from the <install_path>/IBM/WebShpere/AppServer/lib/ext directory so that the directory contained only two jar files:
- `E3.S16`: - authentication-websphere.jar
- log4j_1.2.13.jar
- `E3.S17`: 3. Deleted WorkplaceXT folder from the WAS wstemp folder, and clear the browser cache
4. Started WebSphere Application Server
- `E3.S18`: After implementing the above procedure, the problem was resolved. User started to get a logon prompt only once as expected.

This message may be displayed when the Application Engine (Workplace) is unable to access the configuration files directory.
- `E4.S8`: DIAGNOSING THE PROBLEM
Inspect the contents of the deployed web.xml for the Workplace application ( typically under the J2EE application server deployed directory ...\Workplace\WEB-INF\web.xml).
- `E4.S9`: The configurationDirectory parameter indicates the location of the AE configuration files directory, for example on Microsoft Windows, it may indicate :

- `E5.S1`: java.lang.NullPointerException; workplacext bootstrap; user display name TECHNOTE (TROUBLESHOOTING)
- `E5.S2`: PROBLEM(ABSTRACT)
 After logging into FileNet Workplace XT, a java.lang.NullPointerException error is logged when bootstrapping the object store or when accessing Site Preferences/Access Role.
- `E5.S3`: SYMPTOM
Error Stack Trace extracted from the J2EE Application Server error log:
- `E5.S4`: java.lang.NullPointerException
- `E5.S5`: at org.apache.jasper.runtime.JspWriterImpl.write(JspWriterImpl.java:421)
- `E5.S6`: at com.filenet.wcm.apps.server.ui.info.prefs.PrefAccessRolesInfoPage.renderRoleMembers(PrefAccessRolesInfoPage.java:254)

- `E5.S10`: CAUSE
This behavior may occur if an invalid entry has been specified in the User Display Name Attribute or Group Display Name Attribute setting in the Directory Services Configuration in FileNet Enterprise Manager (FEM).
- `E5.S11`: Workplace XT attempts to resolve the user names and groups defined within the Access Roles based on the Directory Service configuration defined in FEM. If the user name query resolves to null or if there is an invalid entry a NullPointerException error may occur.
- `E5.S12`: RESOLVING THE PROBLEM
 In FEM, change the User Display Name Attribute or Group Display Name Attribute to a valid LDAP entry such as cn, displayName or uid and restart the FileNet Content Engine and Workplace XT instances.

Status: `ANSWER`

Visible answer:
The NullPointerException is caused by an invalid value in the User Display Name Attribute or Group Display Name Attribute configured under Directory Services Configuration in FileNet Enterprise Manager (FEM). [E5.S10]

Workplace XT resolves users and groups in Access Roles using the FEM Directory Services configuration; a null result from the user-name query or another invalid entry can trigger the exception. [E5.S11]

In FEM, change the User Display Name Attribute or Group Display Name Attribute to a valid LDAP attribute, such as cn, displayName, or uid, then restart the FileNet Content Engine and Workplace XT instances. [E5.S12]

## techqa_DEV_Q205#row-0022

Question:
Launching IBM Rational Software Architect application results in Error: Java was started but returned exit code = -1 At times when you launch Rational Software Architect (RSA) application, you might encounter the following error: Error: Java was started but returned exit code = -1 

Reference / gold answer:
This error may indicate a problem with the Java Virtual Machine (JVM) when launching IBM Rational Software Architect. To resolve this issue, you can try updating the video driver to the newest version, as outdated or incompatible drivers can cause JVM termination errors. Another possible cause could be related to a bug in the Intel Graphic Card driver for Windows XP Service Pack 3. If updating the video driver does not solve the problem, you should contact Rational support for further assistance.

Reference evidence:
- `2b`:  This technote explains why opening workitem using IBM Rational Team Concert integrated with Rational Software Architect crashes with the error "JVM terminated.
- `2c`: Exit code=8096" .
- `2d`: It also provides instructions to resolve the issue. SYMPTOM

=== CANDIDATE A ===

- `E3.S2`: PROBLEM(ABSTRACT)
 When profiling an application in execution time analysis mode on a WebSphere Application Server running with newer Java JVM, the WebSphere Application Server might crash and user might not be able to get any profiling data.
- `E3.S3`: This problem affects all supported versions of WebSphere Application Server traditional or Liberty server running on Java 6, 7 or 8 JVMs from January 2017 or later. This could occur when the server is installed locally or remotely. For remote scenarios, this could occur when using the workbench with Rational Agent Controller v96 or older releases on all supported platforms.
- `E3.S4`: SYMPTOM
When starting WebSphere Application Server in profiling mode performing execution time analysis, the JVM might crash resulting in WebSphere Application Server being stopped and no profiling data being collected. You might see a dialog indicating that the C++ runtime library has a runtime error.
- `E3.S5`: In the WebSphere Application Server native_stderr.log for the server, you might see the following error:
- `E3.S6`: [Error: EC JPIAgent received message (FATAL ERROR): Internal error (see log file).]
- `E3.S7`: The server's native_stderr.log can be found in the WebSphere Application Server installation directory in a location such as:
- `E3.S8`: [WAS install directory]\profiles\AppSrv01\logs\server1\native_stderr.log
- `E3.S9`: CAUSE
The January Java 6, Java 7 and Java 8 JDK driver contains a security vulnerability fix that reports error when running code instrumented for execution time analysis profiling
- `E3.S10`: RESOLVING THE PROBLEM
For scenarios where the server is local to the workbench, refer to the following document for installing a fix to the workbench:
- `E3.S11`: http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg22001889 [http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg22001889]
- `E3.S12`: For scenarios where the server is remote, install Rational Agent Controller v9.6.1 or newer on the same machine as the server before trying execution time analysis profiling again.
- `E3.S13`: Contact IBM Support [https://www.ibm.com/contact] if you require further assistance.
- `E3.S14`: Cross reference information Segment Product Component Platform Version Edition Software Development Rational Software Architect for WebSphere Software 9.1.2.2, 9.5.0.2, 9.6 Software Development Rational Developer for i 9.0.1, 9.1, 9.1.1, 9.1.1.1, 9.5, 9.5.0.1, 9.5.0.2, 9.5.0.3, 9.5.1, 9.5.1.1, 9.5.1.2 Software Development Rational Developer for Power Systems Software 8.5.1 Software Development Rational Developer for AIX and Linux 9.0.1, 9.1, 9.1.1, 9.1.1.1, 9.1.1.2, 9.1.1.3, 9.1.1.4 Business Integration IBM Integration Designer 8.5.7, 8.5.6, 8.5.5, 8.5.1.2, 8.5.1.1, 8.5.0.1
